```python
     "SRC_PERF_060 W 欄；Checks V1 J 欄；DB_Evidence E384", "v13.1 已建；待回查"),
    ("D15-12", "D15：每則提示 token 數的區間不動，閉合值的差距標為『未解釋』",
     "Alloc_In C15 區間 2,000–11,000 不動。v13.0 閉合值 L1_TokPerPromptClose＝38,186，為區間上限 11,000 的 3.5 倍，屬未解釋；閉合值是殘差（由 Alloc_In C23、C24 推出），不作為放寬輸入區間的證據。"
     "說明寫入 L1_GapPrompt 列的讀法欄與 Gov_Map GM587 的 N 欄。數值不改。",
     "L1 第 70 列 I 欄；Gov_Map GM587 N 欄", "v13.1 已建"),
]
DECISIONS_V1310 = [[i, "D15 來源補齊", t, txt, DATE, DEC_BY, st, where, f"{WO} P1；{REPORT} 明細第 5 頁", "否"] for i, t, txt, where, st in _D]


def decisions_append(wb):
    ws = wb["Decisions"]
    have = {ws.cell(r, 1).value for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)}
    r = max([rr for rr in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(rr, 1).value not in (None, "")] or [4]) + 1
    n = 0
    for row in DECISIONS_V1310:
        if row[0] in have: continue
        for i, v in enumerate(row): put(ws, f"{L(i + 1)}{r}", v, F_CALC, wrap=i in (2, 3, 5, 7))
        r += 1; n += 1
    assert r - 1 <= 1000, "Decisions beyond Gov_Map AA's COUNTIF span ($A$5:$A$1000)"      # v15.3 W4: span widened from 300
    return n


# ================================================================== P1 notes in builder-owned and Excel-owned pages
def notes(wb, append_text):
    log = {}
    # Arch F6:F8 (revision 9: original wording kept in G of the same row)
    ws = wb["Arch"]; n = 0
    for r in (6, 7, 8):
        if ws[f"F{r}"].value == "Verified／Assumed":
            ws[f"F{r}"].value = "Assumed"; n += 1
        n += append_text(ws[f"G{r}"], f" ｜v13.1 更正（修訂九，Decisions D15-10）：標記欄原字樣『Verified／Assumed』更正為『Assumed』（以 Gov_Map 為準；Luna／Sol 欄數值連結 SRC_MOD，Astra 欄無公開來源）")
    log["arch_marks"] = n
    # SRC_PERF_060 (Excel-owned): note in 備註 W; 狀態 O stays Active
    sp = wb["SRC_Perf"]; n = 0
    for r in range(5, sp.max_row + 1):
        if sp.cell(r, 1).value == "SRC_PERF_060":
            n += append_text(sp.cell(r, 23), "【狀態：待回查（MLCommons v5.1 原始資料找不到 H200 Server 556；2026-10-17）】原始資料 deepseek-r1 共 17 列，H200 只有 HPE Open 組 Offline 一列（每 GPU 1,113.1）；本欄值轉引 3A 查證，未回原文；見 E384、Decisions D15-11")
    log["perf060"] = n
    # Checks V1 說明欄 J
    ck = wb["Checks"]
    r = next(x for x in range(1, ck.max_row + 1) if ck.cell(x, 1).value == "V1")
    log["checks_v1"] = append_text(ck.cell(r, 10), "｜v13.1 D15：對照值未回查（SRC_PERF_060＝556 待回查：MLCommons v5.1 原始資料找不到 H200 Server 556；2026-10-17；Decisions D15-11）")
    # L1_GapPrompt 讀法欄 I
    l1 = wb["L1"]
    r = next(x for x in range(1, l1.max_row + 1) if l1.cell(x, 1).value == "L1_GapPrompt")
    log["l1_gapprompt"] = append_text(l1.cell(r, 9), TOKEN_NOTE)
    # second-source fields (Excel-owned; written only while R is empty): SRC_HW_067／068 -> Lenovo; the new rows carry theirs through v1100-style apply
    sec = {x["id"]: x["second"] for x in SRC_NEW if x.get("second")}
    k = 0
    for sh in ("SRC_DC", "SRC_Price", "SRC_HW"):
        w = wb[sh]
        for rr in range(5, w.max_row + 1):
            i = w.cell(rr, 1).value
            if i in sec and w.cell(rr, 18).value in (None, DASH, ""):
                w.cell(rr, 18).value = sec[i]; k += 1
            if i in ("SRC_HW_067", "SRC_HW_068") and w.cell(rr, 18).value in (None, DASH, ""):
                w.cell(rr, 18).value = "SRC_HW_069" if i == "SRC_HW_067" else "SRC_HW_070"; k += 1
    log["second_sources"] = k
    return log


# ================================================================== P2-1／P2-2: Alloc O note, Alloc P (fingerprint), RNG_StaleFlag, Checks RG3
VR200_NOTE = ("（c）v13.1 P2-1：VR200 欄無區間：批次倍數無證據，為點值。已納入區間的 36 個名稱（IF_ 的 15 格名稱）各有 3 格屬 VR200 世代，共 108 格；它們的 Lo／Hi 只涵蓋 GB200／Hopper 倍數，"
              "VR200 倍數（CAL_BatchEtaD 第 4 格＝0.75；Gov_Map H156 區間 0.70–1.0）沒有證據，故不設區間。VR200 倍數離開 0.75（例如設為 1.0）時，這 108 格與上面（a）的 12 個名稱會落在區間之外或改變。下游應把 VR200 欄當點值使用。")
FP_TITLE = ("P. 區間時效指紋（v13.1 P2-2）：下列為『53 個有區間的名稱』上游的全部數值常數格（依賴圖，口徑同死格偵測；builder/v1310_fingerprint.json，tools/gen_fingerprint.py 產生）。"
            "D 欄是產生端點時記錄的值（黑字常數，不是公式），C 欄是現值（連結），E 欄＝1 表示不符。任一格不符，RNG_StaleFlag 與 Checks RG3 顯示『區間過期』——"
            "即使基準仍在 Lo／Hi 之內（舊旗標只在基準出界或版本不符時亮起）。上游輸入改動後須重新產生端點檔與指紋檔。")


def _last_row(ws):
    return max(c.row for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.value is not None)


def alloc_fingerprint(wb):
    ws = wb["Alloc"]
    # P2-1 note directly under the (b) line of section O
    rb = next(r for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1) if str(ws.cell(r, 1).value or "").startswith("（b）依賴圖上有路徑"))
    if ws.cell(rb + 1, 1).value in (None, ""):
        put(ws, f"A{rb + 1}", VR200_NOTE, F_NOTE)
    r0 = _last_row(ws) + 2
    section(ws, r0, FP_TITLE, 18)
    leaves = FP["leaves"]
    r = r0 + 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "指紋格數", F_BOLD); r_n = r
    r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "指紋不符格數（現值≠產生端點時的值）", F_BOLD); r_d = r
    r += 2
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "工作表", F_BOLD); put(ws, f"B{r}", "儲存格", F_BOLD); put(ws, f"C{r}", "現值（連結）", F_BOLD)
    put(ws, f"D{r}", "產生端點時的值（常數）", F_BOLD); put(ws, f"E{r}", "不符（1＝不符）", F_BOLD)
    r += 1
    first = r
    for sh, cell, val in leaves:
        put(ws, f"A{r}", sh); put(ws, f"B{r}", cell)
        put(ws, f"C{r}", f"='{sh}'!{cell}", F_LINK)
        put(ws, f"D{r}", val, F_CALC)
        put(ws, f"E{r}", f"=IF(ABS(C{r}-D{r})<=1E-9*ABS(D{r})+1E-12,0,1)", F_CALC, fmt="0")
        r += 1
    last = r - 1
    put(ws, f"C{r_n}", f"=COUNT(C{first}:C{last})", F_CALC, fmt="0")
    put(ws, f"C{r_d}", f"=SUM(E{first}:E{last})", F_CALC, fmt="0")
    put(ws, f"D{r_n}", "指紋檔的葉格數（builder/v1310_fingerprint.json）；tests/parity 以依賴圖重新推導並要求逐格相等", F_NOTE)
    put(ws, f"D{r_d}", "不為 0＝上游輸入已改動而端點未重新產生；Checks RG3（WARN）", F_NOTE)
    put(ws, f"Y{r_n}", "顯示用：指紋格數（C 欄）無公式讀取；與指紋檔葉格數的對照由 tests/parity 檢查", F_NOTE)      # 死格需有『用途』標記（Alloc 用途欄＝Y）
    # RNG_StaleFlag also requires the fingerprint to match
    ref = wb.defined_names["RNG_StaleFlag"].attr_text.split("!")[1].replace("$", "")
    cell = ws[ref]
    old = str(cell.value)
    if f"C{r_d}" not in old:
        assert old.startswith("=IF(AND(") and ',C' in old, old
        cell.value = old.replace(f'=0),"一致"', f'=0,C{r_d}=0),"一致"', 1)
        assert f"C{r_d}=0" in cell.value, cell.value
    rf = int(ref[1:])
    dcell = ws[f"D{rf}"]
    if "指紋" not in str(dcell.value):
        dcell.value = str(dcell.value) + "；v13.1：另需 P 節指紋全部相符（任一上游輸入與產生端點時不同也顯示『區間過期』）"
    return {"first": first, "last": last, "n": len(leaves), "fp_row": r_d, "count_row": r_n}


def checks_rg3(wb, fp):
    ws = wb["Checks"]
    r2 = next(r for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(r, 1).value == "RG2")
    r3 = r2 + 1
    assert ws.cell(r3, 1).value in (None, "", "RG3"), ws.cell(r3, 1).value
    put(ws, f"A{r3}", "RG3")
    put(ws, f"B{r3}", "批次口徑區間：上游輸入指紋不符（Alloc P 節）：任一上游數值常數格與產生端點時的值不同：1＝是（基準可能仍在 Lo／Hi 之內；計入 GOV_Warnings 時與 RG2 合算最多 1）", wrap=True)
    put(ws, f"C{r3}", "WARN")
    put(ws, f"D{r3}", f"=IF(Alloc!$C${fp['fp_row']}>0,1,0)", F_CALC, fmt="0")
    put(ws, f"E{r3}", "Alloc P 節 C 欄（不符格數）；builder/v1310_fingerprint.json", F_NOTE)
    ref = wb.defined_names["GOV_Warnings"].attr_text.split("!")[1].replace("$", "")
    cell = ws[ref]
    f = str(cell.value)
    if f"MAX(D{r2},D{r3})" not in f:
        assert f.endswith(f"+D{r2}"), f
        cell.value = f[: -len(f"+D{r2}")] + f"+MAX(D{r2},D{r3})"
    lab = ws[f"B{int(ref[1:])}"]
    if "RG3" not in str(lab.value):
        lab.value = str(lab.value).replace("、RG1、RG2）", "、RG1、RG2、RG3）") if "、RG1、RG2）" in str(lab.value) else f"{lab.value}、RG3"
    return r3


# ================================================================== end of build
def apply(wb, append_text):
    log = {}
    log["notes"] = notes(wb, append_text)
    log["evidence_col_r"] = evidence_col_r(wb)
    log["decisions"] = decisions_append(wb)
    fp = alloc_fingerprint(wb)
    log["fingerprint"] = fp
    log["rg3_row"] = checks_rg3(wb, fp)
    return log


# ================================================================== README
README_VERSION = (VERSION + "（次版：" + WO + "——P1 D15 來源補齊（Gov_Map 312 列補 J／H 欄、Decisions D15-01…12、新 SRC：SRC_DC_018／019、SRC_PRC_045／046、SRC_HW_069／070，DB_Evidence R 欄與 E381–E386，"
                  "Arch E6–E8 標記更正，SRC_PERF_060 待回查）；P2 查核 #96 小項（VR200 欄為點值的說明、區間時效指紋 Alloc P 節與 Checks RG3、C68 O 欄文字）；數值全部不變）。以下為 "
                  + v1300.README_VERSION.split("_Tokenomics_", 1)[1])
_T = v1300.README_TITLE
README_TITLE = V + _T[len(v1300.V):]
README_ROW = ("D15 來源補齊與區間時效指紋（v13.1）",
              "Gov_Map 無來源無決策列補登決策編號與來源；新增 6 筆 SRC；DB_Evidence 積壓 106 列加建議處置欄；區間時效旗標加上游輸入指紋（Alloc P 節、Checks RG3）。數值不變。細節見 Decisions D15-*。")
```

```python
# v14.0 (work order docs/workorders/20261017_4-3B.md, branch claude/4-3b; slimming 4-3 B: execute the A-stage recommendations).
# Major version: new contract names (11 IF_ on Interface M, 7 L1_ series on Cap_In) are added; no existing IF_／IFW_／L1_／RNG_ value changes.
#   Q1  delete the cells of 73 rows (72 A-stage rows with disposition 刪除 + Har_In 44; builder/v1400_data.json, tools/gen_v1400_data.py):

#   Q2  18 names: Interface M (IF_TaskTokMult, IF_TrainFLOP_／IF_TrainInferShare_／IF_GMDefault_ × Luna／Sol／Astra, IF_AmortRevShare)
#       and series names on Cap_In (L1_MAPI_Ser, L1_MSub_Ser, L1_MSeat_Ser, L1_MImplied_Ser, L1_MFleet_Ser, L1_MFleet_P25Lo, L1_MFleet_P25Hi).
#       Luna／Sol／Astra are 層級 (tiers), not generations. L1_MFleetFloor is NOT upgraded (Q3: definition open, see report).
#   Q4  Checks V23–V26 (counted in the verification count) and Checks D104／D140 re-pointed to Alloc_In C18／C33 (single definition).
#   Q5  用途 marks for the 155 kept display rows (builder/v1400_data.json) and for the cells that became dead through Q1 (v1400_marks.json).
# Every write to an Excel-owned cell is guarded (old value / old text).
import json
from pathlib import Path

import openpyxl
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter as L
from openpyxl.workbook.defined_name import DefinedName
from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill

from common import put, F_NOTE, F_BOLD, F_CALC, section
import v1310

VERSION = "20261017_Tokenomics_v14.0"      # single source of the version string: README!B5 and README!A1 (finish.readme)
DATE = "2026-10-17"
V = "v14.0"
WO = "工作單 docs/workorders/20261017_4-3B.md"
DEC_BY = "Andy 2026-10-17 09:18（Har_In 44 刪除）；其餘依 4-3 A 段建議與本工作單（chat 端 2026-10-17 定案，可撤回）"
DASH = "—"
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA = json.loads((HERE / "v1400_data.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
_MJ = HERE / "v1400_marks.json"

NO_FILL = PatternFill(fill_type=None)

PURPOSE_HDR_ROW = 3

H157_OLD = "選定檔案『供應商專屬』時，前緣組合綁定該供應商 API（Har_In 旗標）。"
H157_NEW = ""
H157_A = "前緣只比較成本，不含延遲；"
H157_A_NEW = "前緣只比較成本，不含延遲。"      # the sentence about the vendor flag is dropped; the clause before it now ends the sentence


# ================================================================== Q1: delete cells
def _cells(rng):
    c1, r1, c2, r2 = openpyxl.utils.range_boundaries(rng)
    return [(r, c) for r in range(r1, r2 + 1) for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)]


def _purpose_col(ws, create=True):
    last = 0
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            if cell.value is not None:
                last = max(last, cell.column)
    for c in range(3, last + 1):
        if ws.cell(PURPOSE_HDR_ROW, c).value == PURPOSE:
            return c
    if not create:
        return None
    col = last + 1
    put(ws, f"{L(col)}{PURPOSE_HDR_ROW}", PURPOSE, F_BOLD)
    ws.column_dimensions[L(col)].width = 46
    return col


def delete_cells(wb):
    n_cells = n_rows = 0
    for e in DATA["delete"]:
        ws = wb[e["sheet"]]
        for r, c in _cells(e["range"]):
            cell = ws.cell(r, c)
            if cell.value is not None:
                cell.value = None; cell.fill = NO_FILL; n_cells += 1
        pc = _purpose_col(ws)
        put(ws, f"{L(pc)}{e['row']}", DEL_NOTE.format(rng=e["range"]), F_NOTE)
        n_rows += 1
    removed = []
    for n, ref in REMOVE_NAMES.items():
        if n in wb.defined_names:
            assert wb.defined_names[n].attr_text == ref, (n, wb.defined_names[n].attr_text)
            del wb.defined_names[n]; removed.append(n)
    ws = wb["Harness"]
    t = ws["A157"].value
    if isinstance(t, str) and H157_OLD in t:
        t = t.replace(H157_A + H157_OLD, H157_A_NEW)
        assert H157_OLD not in t, "Harness A157 sentence not removed"
        ws["A157"].value = t
    return dict(rows=n_rows, cells=n_cells, names=removed)


# ================================================================== Q5: 用途 marks
def purpose_marks(wb):
    n = 0
    plan = {sh: dict(rows) for sh, rows in DATA["marks"].items()}
    for sh, rows in EXTRA.get("marks", {}).items():
        plan.setdefault(sh, {}).update(rows)
    for sh, rows in NAME_MARKS.items():
        plan.setdefault(sh, {}).update(rows)
    deleted = {(e["sheet"], e["row"]) for e in DATA["delete"]}
    for sh, rows in plan.items():
        ws = wb[sh]
        pc = _purpose_col(ws)
        for r, txt in rows.items():
            assert (sh, int(r)) not in deleted, ("mark on a deleted row", sh, r)
            put(ws, f"{L(pc)}{int(r)}", txt, F_NOTE); n += 1
    return n


# ================================================================== Q2: names
M_TITLE = ("M. 契約補名（v14.0，工作單 4-3B Q2）：18 個名稱中的 11 個 IF_ 名稱；其餘 7 個 L1_ 序列名稱在 Cap_In（見下游契約文件）。"
           "Luna／Sol／Astra 是模型層級（低／中／頂），不是世代；欄＝世代 × 成本情境（任務別列：欄 C–G＝Workload 任務）。"
           "每列標明層級與 token 類型；『混合』＝該值本身是跨 token 類型的混合比值，不能拆回單一類型")
TIERS = [("Luna", "Luna（低層）"), ("Sol", "Sol（中層）"), ("Astra", "Astra（頂層）")]
GM_ROW = {"Luna": 24, "Sol": 42, "Astra": 60}


def interface_m(wb):
    ws = wb["Interface"]
    start = max(c.row for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.value is not None) + 2
    section(ws, start, M_TITLE, 17)
    r = start + 1
    made = []

    def name_it(name, ref):
        wb.defined_names[name] = DefinedName(name, attr_text=ref)

    # task-level multiple (columns C–G = Workload tasks)
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "任務總 token ÷ 一般聊天總 token（欄 C–G＝Workload 任務，同 E 節 IF_HdrTask；任務別，非模型層級；"
                     "token 類型＝總 token：新鮮輸入＋快取輸入＋decode，混合）　[IF_TaskTokMult]"); put(ws, f"B{r}", "x")
    for k in range(3, 8):
        X = L(k); put(ws, f"{X}{r}", f"=Workload!{X}38", fmt="0.0")
    name_it("IF_TaskTokMult", f"Interface!$C${r}:$G${r}"); made.append(("IF_TaskTokMult", r)); r += 1

        rows = [

             "FLOP", FLOPS_FMT, pick(109)),
            (f"IF_TrainInferShare_{tk}", f"推論型占最終訓練（GPU 小時口徑；{tn[:tn.index('（')]}層級；rollout 等推論型工作占最終訓練 GPU 小時；訓練側，無 token 類型）",
             "%", "0.0%", pick(114)),

             "%", "0.0%", "=Theory_Rev!{X}" + str(GM_ROW[tk])),
        ]
        for name, lab, unit, fmt, tpl in rows:
            put(ws, f"A{r}", f"{lab}　[{name}]"); put(ws, f"B{r}", unit)
            for k in range(3, 18):
                X = L(k); put(ws, f"{X}{r}", tpl.replace("{X}", X), fmt=fmt)
            name_it(name, f"Interface!$C${r}:$Q${r}"); made.append((name, r)); r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "攤提占付費營收（K6 (d) 口徑：由上而下年化總額 ÷ 付費營收合計（OpenAI 有效單價，可達層級）；各層級相同；"
                     "營收類型＝付費營收，混合）　[IF_AmortRevShare]"); put(ws, f"B{r}", "%")
    for k in range(3, 18):
        X = L(k); put(ws, f"{X}{r}", f"=Amortize!{X}49", fmt="0.0%")
    name_it("IF_AmortRevShare", f"Interface!$C${r}:$Q${r}"); made.append(("IF_AmortRevShare", r))
    return dict(start=start, made=made)

def checks_fix(wb):
    """D104／D140 read Alloc_In C18／C33 (single definition); V-row number formats for the tolerance bands."""
    ws = wb["Checks"]
    n = 0
    for r, old, new, eold, enew in (
            (104, "=IF(ABS(SUM(AL_MixGen)-1)>0.000000001,1,0)", "=IF(ABS(Alloc_In!$C$18-1)>0.000000001,1,0)",
             "Alloc_In 世代組合四格", "Alloc_In 第 18 列（服務世代組合合計；C18＝SUM(AL_MixGen)，單一定義；v14.0）"),
            (140, "=IF(ABS(AL_RDMixHopper+AL_RDMixGB200+AL_RDMixGB300+AL_RDMixVR200-1)>0.000000001,1,0)", "=IF(ABS(Alloc_In!$C$33-1)>0.000000001,1,0)",
             "Alloc_In 研發世代組合四格（基準欄）", "Alloc_In 第 33 列（研發世代組合合計；C33＝四格之和，單一定義；v14.0）")):
        assert ws[f"A{r}"].value in ("H1", "Z2"), (r, ws[f"A{r}"].value)
        cur = ws[f"D{r}"].value
        nm = lambda x: str(x).replace("0.000000001", "1E-9")      # the builder writes 1E-9, LibreOffice saves 0.000000001
        assert nm(cur) in (nm(old), nm(new)), (r, cur)
        if nm(cur) == nm(old):
            ws[f"D{r}"].value = new; n += 1
        if ws[f"E{r}"].value == eold:
            ws[f"E{r}"].value = enew
    for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
        a = ws.cell(r, 1).value
        if a == "V24":
            ws[f"H{r}"].number_format = "0.0E+00"; ws[f"I{r}"].number_format = "0.0E+00"
        if a == "V26":
            ws[f"H{r}"].number_format = "0.0E+00"; ws[f"I{r}"].number_format = "0.0E+00"
        if a == "V23":
            ws[f"H{r}"].number_format = "0"; ws[f"I{r}"].number_format = "0"
    return n
```

```python
R1_G121_TAIL = "；v14.1 起第 119 列各欄＝MAX(點估計, 本列同欄)，故 L1_MFleet 的 _Lo／基準／_Hi 都不低於各自欄的本列"
R1_MARK_OLD = "顯示用：C121:E121（待定義，見 4-3B 報告）｜物理下限 0.301 與 L1_MFleet_Lo 0.184 的定義不同，三種處理待 Project 判斷；本版不升級為契約名稱"
R1_MARK_NEW = ("公式列：C121:E121（機隊 m 的同欄物理下限；v14.1 正式定義）｜每一欄用該欄自己的服務 GW 與利用率口徑算出『token 上限 → m 下限』；"
               "第 119 列（機隊 m，→ L1_MFleet／_Lo／_Hi）各欄＝MAX(點估計, 本列同欄)；不升級為契約名稱 L1_MFleetFloor（下游不讀此列，只讀截斷後的 L1_MFleet 區間）；"
               "原標記『待定義，見 4-3B 報告』（v14.0）")


def r1_texts(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    n = 0
    for ref, tail in (("G119", R1_G119_TAIL), ("G121", R1_G121_TAIL)):
        cur = ws[ref].value
        assert isinstance(cur, str) and cur.startswith("="), (ref, cur)
        n += append_text(ws[ref], tail)
    pc = _purpose_col(ws)
    n += _set_text(ws, f"{L(pc)}121", R1_MARK_OLD, R1_MARK_NEW)
    return n


# ================================================================== R3: Har_In 20／32
HAR_ROWS = (20, 32)
R3_MARK = "已清空（v14.1，R3）：供應商專屬旗標（輸入）無任何公式讀取（對應的第 44 列已於 v14.0 刪除）；原值 {vals}，原『來源與標記』欄 H、說明欄 I 原文保留；見 Decisions SL44-3"
R3_GM_TAIL = " ｜v14.1 已移除（R3，修訂九更正註記）：Har_In {rng} 的旗標值已清空（無任何公式讀取）；本列原文與原值保留於此與 Decisions SL44-3"


def r3_har_flags(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["Har_In"]
    pc = _purpose_col(ws)
    orig = {}
    n = 0
    for r in HAR_ROWS:
        vals = [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(3, 8)]
        if all(v is None for v in vals):
            continue                              # already cleared (rebuild from v14.1)
        assert ws.cell(r, 1).value == "供應商專屬（1＝是）", (r, ws.cell(r, 1).value)
        orig[r] = vals
        for c in range(3, 8):
            ws.cell(r, c).value = None; ws.cell(r, c).fill = NO_FILL
        put(ws, f"{L(pc)}{r}", R3_MARK.format(vals="／".join(str(v) for v in vals)), F_NOTE)
        n += 1
    gm = 0
    for r in HAR_ROWS:
        rng = f"C{r}:G{r}"
        rows = _gm_rows(wb, "Har_In", rng)
        assert len(rows) == 1, (rng, rows)
        gm += append_text(wb["Gov_Map"][f"N{rows[0]}"], R3_GM_TAIL.format(rng=rng))
    return dict(rows=n, gov_map=gm, orig=orig)


# ================================================================== R4: A／B labels of the 73 v14.0-deleted rows
def r4_labels(wb):
    data = v1400.DATA["delete"]
    lst = []
    n = 0
    for e in data:
        ws = wb[e["sheet"]]
        a, b = ws.cell(e["row"], 1).value, ws.cell(e["row"], 2).value
        if a is None and b is None:
            continue
        lst.append((e["sheet"], e["row"], a, b))
        ws.cell(e["row"], 1).value = None; ws.cell(e["row"], 2).value = None
        n += 1
    return dict(rows=n, list=lst)


# ================================================================== R5: Cap_In 24 cells
R5_ROWS = [185] + list(range(187, 194)) + list(range(196, 203)) + [205] + list(range(216, 223))
R5_CELLS = [f"C{r}" for r in R5_ROWS] + ["G175"]
R5_MARK_OLD_PREFIX = "顯示用：C{r}（H10 的 2025 年度欄"
R5_MARK_NEW = "已清空 C{r}（v14.1，R5）：H10 的 2025 年度欄，原本只與 D–F 欄並列對照、無任何公式讀取（刪除前已逐格確認）；原公式記於 Decisions SL44-5"
R5_G175_MARK_OLD = "顯示用：G175（說明動態文字：現值取代過時數字）｜C175:E175 為殘差讀數，v14.0 起由 Checks V25 讀取"
R5_G175_MARK_NEW = "已清空 G175（v14.1，R5）：說明動態文字無任何公式讀取；C175:E175 為殘差讀數，v14.0 起由 Checks V25 讀取；原公式記於 Decisions SL44-5"


def r5_cap_in(wb):
    from deps import Deps
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    live = [c for c in R5_CELLS if ws[c].value is not None]
    if not live:
        return dict(cleared=0, orig=[], kept=[])
    D = Deps(wb)
    group = {("Cap_In", c) for c in live}
    rev = {}
    for k in D.formulas:
        for p in D.direct(k):
            if p in group:
                rev.setdefault(p, set()).add(k)
    kept = []
    for c in live:
        outside = sorted(k for k in rev.get(("Cap_In", c), ()) if k not in group)
        if outside:
            kept.append((c, outside))
    keep_set = {c for c, _ in kept}
    # a cell whose reader is kept is itself kept (closure); loop until stable
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for c in live:
            if c in keep_set:
                continue
            if any(k[0] == "Cap_In" and k[1] in keep_set for k in rev.get(("Cap_In", c), ())):
                keep_set.add(c); changed = True
    pc = _purpose_col(ws)
    orig = []
    for c in live:
        if c in keep_set:
            continue
        orig.append((c, ws[c].value))
        ws[c].value = None; ws[c].fill = NO_FILL
        r = int(c[1:])
        if c == "G175":
            _set_text(ws, f"{L(pc)}{r}", R5_G175_MARK_OLD, R5_G175_MARK_NEW)
        else:
            cur = ws[f"{L(pc)}{r}"].value
            assert str(cur).startswith(R5_MARK_OLD_PREFIX.format(r=r)), (r, cur)
            ws[f"{L(pc)}{r}"].value = R5_MARK_NEW.format(r=r)
    return dict(cleared=len(orig), orig=orig, kept=[(c, o) for c, o in kept])


# ================================================================== R6
GM629_TAIL = " ｜v14.0 已清空（修訂九更正註記；v14.1 R6 補記）：Cap_In C204:F204 的值已於 v14.0（4-3B Q1）清空，本列原文保留"
ANCHOR_ROWS = (206, 207, 208, 209, 223)
ANCHOR_NEW = "錨點：以本列 C–F 欄現值為準（v5.35 B1 建置時的數字已刪除，避免與現值不一致；原文見 Decisions SL44-6）"
MARK_FIX = [
    ("Cap_In", 76, "顯示用：C76（H2 訂閱人數（SRC_DEM 複本與 2025 期間平均）：每人直覺檢查與 ARPU 的上游）",
     "顯示用：C76（H2 訂閱人數的 SRC_DEM 複本，只供與 2025 期間平均並列對照；目前沒有任何公式讀取；v14.1 R6 更正：原標記稱『每人直覺檢查與 ARPU 的上游』與實際依賴不符）"),
    ("Training", 122, "顯示用：C122:Q122（核心列：Sens_Train 有同列同標籤的列，常設測試以此為逐格比對基準；下游用 IF_TrainCost_*／IF_ProgCost_*）",
     "顯示用：C122:Q122（核心列：Sens_Train 有同列同標籤的列，常設測試以此為逐格比對基準；本列沒有公式讀取，下游 IF_TrainCost_*／IF_ProgCost_* 實際讀第 120 列（研發計畫 GPU 小時，TRN_GPUhProg）；v14.1 R6 更正）"),
    ("Price_Frontier", 27, "顯示用：C27:E27（前緣分項牌價（新鮮輸入／快取輸入／輸出）：B 節前緣表的形狀；下游用 IF_FrontRef_*（混合））",
     "顯示用：C27:E27（前緣分項牌價（新鮮輸入／快取輸入／輸出）：B 節前緣表的形狀；本列沒有公式讀取，下游 IF_FrontRef_* 實際讀第 46 列（B4_FrontRef，前緣混合單價）；v14.1 R6 更正）"),
]


def r6_small(wb, append_text):
    log = {}
    gm = _gm_rows(wb, "Cap_In", "C204:F204")
    assert len(gm) == 1, gm
    log["gm629"] = append_text(wb["Gov_Map"][f"N{gm[0]}"], GM629_TAIL)
    n = 0
    for sh, r, old, new in MARK_FIX:
        ws = wb[sh]
        pc = _purpose_col(ws)
        n += _set_text(ws, f"{L(pc)}{r}", old, new)
    log["marks"] = n
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    orig = []
    for r in ANCHOR_ROWS:
        cur = ws[f"H{r}"].value
        if cur == ANCHOR_NEW:
            continue
        assert isinstance(cur, str) and cur.startswith("錨點：") and not cur.startswith("錨點：以本列"), (r, cur)
        orig.append((r, cur))
        ws[f"H{r}"].value = ANCHOR_NEW
    log["anchors"] = len(orig)
    log["anchor_orig"] = orig
    return log


# ================================================================== Decisions
def _decisions(r3, r4, r5, r6):
    lab = "；".join(f"{s}!{r}：{a}｜{b}" for s, r, a, b in r4["list"])
    r5t = "；".join(f"Cap_In!{c}：{f}" for c, f in r5["orig"])
    r6t = "；".join(f"Cap_In!H{r}：{t}" for r, t in r6["anchor_orig"])
    _D = [
        ("1", "R1 機隊 m 低端改用『同欄下限』（下限截斷）",
         "Cap_In 第 119 列（機隊 m，C 基準／D token 取高／E token 取低）各欄改為 MAX(該欄點估計, 該欄第 121 列的物理下限)；第 121 列每一欄用該欄自己的服務 GW 與利用率口徑算出，"
         "所以低端欄（D）的下限是 0.215（不是基準欄的 0.301）。原因（4-3B 報告第 6 節）：D 欄 token 取高的點估計 token（423 億）高於它自己那一欄的上限（361 億，比值 1.17），"
         "兩者差在服務 GW 與利用率修正的口徑不同，造成 L1_MFleet_Lo 0.184 低於物理下限。處理：下限截斷（Andy 選 (b)）。基準 0.407 與高端 1.179 高於各自欄的下限，不受影響。"
         "機制寫在 Excel 公式（Cap_In 第 119 列）；說明欄寫明『下限截斷：v14.1 起，低端不得低於同欄物理下限』。Cap_In 第 121 列用途由『待定義』改為正式定義；不升級為契約名稱 L1_MFleetFloor（下游不讀）。"
         "受影響的名稱：L1_MFleet_Lo、L1_PriceRealFleet_Lo、L1_LReqFleet_Hi（及其依賴格 Cap_In E240／E242、CHK_L1Order、GOV_Warnings 的輸入；新舊值見報告）。",
         "Cap_In 第 119、121 列；L1 第 78 列", "v14.1 已建"),
        ("2", "R2 V23、V24 標『恆等式（非驗證）』",
         "Checks V23（Perf 實際速度 ≥ SLO）與 V24（Cap_In 第 147 列＝L1_MImplied）是結構性恆等式（4-3B 報告第 5 節）：定義上恆成立，無法只靠改輸入使其失敗。比照 V18，F 欄改顯示文字『恆等式（非驗證）』，"
         "移出驗證項目數／通過／失敗；公式被改壞時 F 欄顯示『恆等式不成立』，專屬必須失敗測試保留（改公式格）。驗證計數 24／16／7／1 → 22／14／7／1。",
         "Checks V23、V24；CHK_VerifyTotal／Pass", "v14.1 已建"),
        ("3", "R3 Har_In 第 20、32 列供應商旗標清空",
         "供應商專屬旗標（Har_In 第 20、32 列 C:G）自第 44 列於 v14.0 刪除後已無任何公式讀取，v14.1 清空。原值：" +
         "；".join(f"第 {r} 列 " + "／".join(str(v) for v in vals) for r, vals in sorted(r3["orig"].items())) +
         "。H 欄（來源與標記）與 I 欄（說明）原文保留；Gov_Map 該兩列（列 493、501）加註『v14.1 已移除』，原文保留（修訂九）。需要時再接線。",
         "Har_In 第 20、32 列；Gov_Map 列 493、501（GM489、GM497）", "v14.1 已建"),
        ("4", "R4 v14.0 刪除的 73 列：A、B 欄標籤清空",
         "v14.0（SL43-1）刪除的 73 列，v14.1 一併清空 A、B 欄標籤。可追溯清單（工作表!列：原 A 欄｜原 B 欄）：" + lab,
         "各頁（見清單）", "v14.1 已建"),
        ("5", "R5 Cap_In 24 格清空",
         "Cap_In 第 185、187–193、196–202、205、216–222 列 C 欄（23 格）與第 175 列說明文字格 G175，刪除前以依賴圖逐格確認：這 24 格的讀者全部在這 24 格之內（沒有任何其他格、名稱、Checks 讀取），所以整組清空。"
         "保留（有組外讀者）：" + ("無" if not r5["kept"] else "；".join(f"{c}：{o}" for c, o in r5["kept"])) + "。原公式：" + r5t,
         "Cap_In C 欄上述各列；G175", "v14.1 已建"),
        ("6", "R6 v14.0 獨立查核（PR #104）的小項",
         "(1) Gov_Map GM629（Cap_In C204:F204）加註『v14.0 已清空』，原文保留。(2) 用途標記三筆更正：Cap_In 76（實際無公式讀取）、Training 122（下游實為第 120 列）、Price_Frontier 27（下游實為第 46 列）；原標記文字保留於各列 O／該頁用途欄的更正句。"
         "(3) Cap_In 第 206–209、223 列 H 欄『錨點』舊文字與現值不符，改為『以本列 C–F 欄現值為準』；原文：" + r6t + "。數值全部不變。",
         "Gov_Map GM629；Cap_In 76、206–209、223；Training 122；Price_Frontier 27", "v14.1 已建"),
    ]
    return [[f"SL44-{i}", V, f"v14.1 修補：{t}", txt, DATE, DEC_BY, st, where, f"{WO} R{i}", "否"] for i, t, txt, where, st in _D]


def decisions_append(wb, rows):
    ws = wb["Decisions"]
    have = {ws.cell(r, 1).value for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)}
    r = max([rr for rr in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(rr, 1).value not in (None, "")] or [4]) + 1
    n = 0
    for row in rows:
        if row[0] in have:
            continue
        for i, v in enumerate(row):
            put(ws, f"{L(i + 1)}{r}", v, F_CALC, wrap=i in (2, 3, 5, 7))
        r += 1; n += 1
    return n


def old_decision_tail(wb, append_text):
    """SL43-4 (v14.0) says V23–V26 are counted in the verification count: add the v14.1 R2 correction."""
    ws = wb["Decisions"]
    for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
        if ws.cell(r, 1).value == "SL43-4":
            return append_text(ws[f"D{r}"], " ｜v14.1 R2：V23、V24 已改標『恆等式（非驗證）』，移出驗證計數（見 SL44-2）；V25、V26 仍計入")
    return 0


# ================================================================== apply
def apply(wb, append_text):
    log = {}
    log["r1_texts"] = r1_texts(wb, append_text)
    log["r3"] = r3_har_flags(wb, append_text)
    log["r4"] = r4_labels(wb)
    log["r5"] = r5_cap_in(wb)
    log["r6"] = r6_small(wb, append_text)
    ws = wb["Decisions"]
    have_dec = any(ws.cell(r, 1).value == "SL44-1" for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1))
    if not have_dec:
        # lists come from the live sheets before clearing; on a rebuild from v14.1 the sheets are rebuilt so they are complete again
        log["decisions"] = decisions_append(wb, _decisions(log["r3"], log["r4"], log["r5"], log["r6"]))
        log["sl43_4"] = old_decision_tail(wb, append_text)
    return log


# ================================================================== README
README_VERSION = (VERSION + "（次版：" + WO + "——R1 機隊 m 低端改用同欄下限（Cap_In 第 119 列各欄＝MAX(點估計, 第 121 列同欄)；L1_MFleet_Lo 0.184 → 0.215，基準與高端不變）；"
                  "R2 Checks V23、V24 標恆等式（驗證計數 24／16／7／1 → 22／14／7／1）；R3 Har_In 第 20、32 列供應商旗標清空；R4 v14.0 刪除列的 A、B 標籤清空；R5 Cap_In 24 格清空；"
                  "R6 v14.0 獨立查核小項（GM629 註記、三筆用途更正、過時錨點文字）；Decisions SL44-*）。以下為 "
                  + v1400.README_VERSION.split("_Tokenomics_", 1)[1])
_T = v1400.README_TITLE
README_TITLE = V + _T[len(v1400.V):]
README_ROW = ("v14.1 修補",
              "機隊 m 低端改用同欄下限（L1_MFleet_Lo 0.184 → 0.215）；V23、V24 標恆等式；清空無人讀取的旗標與標籤；用途標記與過時文字更正。細節見 Decisions SL44-*。")
```

## v1420.py

```python
# v14.2 (work order docs/workorders/20261017_v14.2修補.md r0, branch claude/v14-2): patch after the v14.1 independent check.
# Minor version: no new contract name; the existing contract names L1_MFleet_P25Lo／L1_MFleet_P25Hi change value (low-end column), everything else unchanged.
#   S1  Cap_In rows 285 (L1_MFleet_P25Lo) and 286 (L1_MFleet_P25Hi), every column C／D／E = MAX(that column's point estimate at its own price, that column's own floor):
#       floor = revenue / (that column's fleet-paid-token ceiling (row 118) x the same price (AL_PriceFleet25_Lo／_Hi)).  Same mechanism as v14.1 R1 (row 119 = MAX(point, floor)),
#       but the floor is taken at the row's OWN price (the row 121 floor is at AL_PriceFleet25, the base 2025 price, so it cannot floor a row priced differently).
#       Excel formulas only; no Python-side computation.  L1_MFleet (all three ends), IF_Alloc*, IF_TokGW_*, RNG_* are not on the chain and do not change.
#   S2  Har_In rows 20／32: A／B labels cleared like v14.1 R4 (original text in Decisions SL45-2); H (source & mark) and I (note) kept (CLAUDE.md section 6).
#   S3  engineering: test rename, v14.1 report header SHAs, CHANGELOG v14.1 merge SHA (outside the workbook).
# Every write to an Excel-owned cell is guarded (old value / old text).
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter as L

import v1400
import v1410

VERSION = "20261017_Tokenomics_v14.2"      # single source of the version string: README!B5 and README!A1 (finish.readme)
DATE = "2026-10-17"
V = "v14.2"
WO = "工作單 docs/workorders/20261017_v14.2修補.md"
DEC_BY = "Andy 2026-10-17 13:04（回覆『全部依照你的建議』，同意 chat 端 S1、S2 的預設）"

HAR_ROWS = (20, 32)
HAR_A = "供應商專屬（1＝是）"
HAR_B = "旗標"
S1_ROWS = {285: "AL_PriceFleet25_Lo", 286: "AL_PriceFleet25_Hi"}
S1_NOTE = ("；下限截斷：v14.2 起比照 v14.1 R1，各欄不得低於『同欄、同單價』的物理下限"
           "＝營收 ÷（該欄機隊付費 token 上限（第 118 列）× {px}）；見 Decisions SL45-1")
OLD_F = '=IF(ISNUMBER({c}116),SRC_DEM_007*1000000000/({c}116*{px}),AL_UnavailTxt)'
NEW_F = ('=IF(ISNUMBER({c}116),MAX(SRC_DEM_007*1000000000/({c}116*{px}),'
         'IF(ISNUMBER({c}118),SRC_DEM_007*1000000000/({c}118*{px}),0)),AL_UnavailTxt)')


def _norm(s):
    return str(s).replace("1E+9", "1000000000").replace("1e9", "1000000000").replace("1E9", "1000000000")


def _purpose_col(ws):
    return v1400._purpose_col(ws, create=False)


# ================================================================== S1
def s1_p25(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    n = 0
    for r, px in S1_ROWS.items():
        assert str(ws[f"A{r}"].value).startswith("m（2025 單價取"), (r, ws[f"A{r}"].value)
        for c in "CDE":
            cur = ws[f"{c}{r}"].value
            old, new = OLD_F.format(c=c, px=px), NEW_F.format(c=c, px=px)
            if _norm(cur) == _norm(new):
                continue
            assert _norm(cur) == _norm(old), (r, c, cur)
            ws[f"{c}{r}"].value = new
            n += 1
        assert isinstance(ws[f"G{r}"].value, str), (r, ws[f"G{r}"].value)
        n += append_text(ws[f"G{r}"], S1_NOTE.format(px=px))
        pc = _purpose_col(ws)
        n += append_text(ws[f"{L(pc)}{r}"], "；v14.2 起下限截斷（比照 v14.1 R1，同欄同單價下限；見 Decisions SL45-1）")
    return n


# ================================================================== S2
S2_MARK_TAIL = "；v14.2 S2：A、B 欄標籤已清空（原『{a}｜{b}』記於 Decisions SL45-2）"


def s2_har_labels(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["Har_In"]
    pc = _purpose_col(ws)
    orig = []
    for r in HAR_ROWS:
        a, b = ws.cell(r, 1).value, ws.cell(r, 2).value
        if a is None and b is None:
            continue
        assert (a, b) == (HAR_A, HAR_B), (r, a, b)
        orig.append((r, a, b))
        ws.cell(r, 1).value = None; ws.cell(r, 2).value = None
        append_text(ws[f"{L(pc)}{r}"], S2_MARK_TAIL.format(a=a, b=b))
    return orig

         "套用到不同單價的列會不一致。v14.1 獨立查核（PR #108）發現：低端欄（D，token 取高）兩列都低於各自的同欄下限（P25Lo 0.3535 對 0.4141；P25Hi 0.1066 對 0.1249）。"

         "tests/parity/test_v1400.py；docs/reports；CHANGELOG.md", "v14.2 已建（Excel 外）"),
    ]
    return [[f"SL45-{i}", V, f"v14.2 修補：{t}", txt, DATE, DEC_BY, st, where, f"{WO} S{i}", "否"] for i, t, txt, where, st in _D]
```

```python
def _purpose_col(ws):

def _norm(s):
    return str(s).replace("1E+9", "1000000000").replace("1e9", "1000000000").replace("1E9", "1000000000")


def _set_guarded(cell, old, new):
    """Write `new` only while the cell still holds `old` (or already holds `new`)."""
    if cell.value == new:
        return 0
    assert cell.value == old, (cell.parent.title, cell.coordinate, cell.value, old)
    cell.value = new
    return 1

Q_TITLE = ("Q. 推論支出區間（v15.0 O13，工作單 r1 T1-1）：SRC_DEM_004_Lo／_Hi（OpenAI 端推論支出 $B 的來源區間）接進支出路線——"
           "服務 GW（IF_AllocServeGW）、Q1（IF_AllocQ1）、Q2（IF_AllocQ2）各取低／高端。全部是公式（隨 SRC_DEM_004 區間即時更新，不是貼值）；"

    ("q2_a", "Q2 @ 支出低端", "%", '=IF(AL_ServeGW="整代不可達","整代不可達",IF(AND(ISNUMBER({srv_a}),ISNUMBER(AL_RDGW)),AL_RDGW*AL_HoldTrain/(AL_RDGW*AL_HoldTrain+{srv_a}*{den}),"SLO 不可達"))'),
    ("q2_b", "Q2 @ 支出高端", "%", '=IF(AL_ServeGW="整代不可達","整代不可達",IF(AND(ISNUMBER({srv_b}),ISNUMBER(AL_RDGW)),AL_RDGW*AL_HoldTrain/(AL_RDGW*AL_HoldTrain+{srv_b}*{den}),"SLO 不可達"))'),
]
Q_NAMES = (("IF_AllocServeGW", "srv"), ("IF_AllocQ1", "q1"), ("IF_AllocQ2", "q2"))


def o13_alloc_q(wb):
    ws = wb["Alloc"]
    if any(str(ws.cell(r, 1).value or "").startswith("Q. 推論支出區間") for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1)):
        return {}
    r0 = max(c.row for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.value is not None) + 2
    section(ws, r0, Q_TITLE, 18)
    r = r0 + 1
    at = {}
    for key, lab, unit, f in Q_ROWS:
        at[key] = f"C{r}"
        put(ws, f"A{r}", lab); put(ws, f"B{r}", unit)
        put(ws, f"C{r}", f.format(**at), F_CALC)
        r += 1
    r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "區間端點（名稱）", F_BOLD); put(ws, f"B{r}", "單位", F_BOLD); put(ws, f"C{r}", "值", F_BOLD)
    put(ws, f"D{r}", "對照：基準（Interface）", F_BOLD); put(ws, f"E{r}", "基準落在區間外（1＝是）", F_BOLD)
    r += 1
    out_cells = []
    for nm, k in Q_NAMES:
        a, b = at[f"{k}_a"], at[f"{k}_b"]
        unit = "GW" if k == "srv" else "%"
        for tag, fn in (("Lo", "MIN"), ("Hi", "MAX")):
            put(ws, f"A{r}", f"RNG_Dem004_{nm}_{tag}"); put(ws, f"B{r}", unit)
            put(ws, f"C{r}", f"=IF(AND(ISNUMBER({a}),ISNUMBER({b})),{fn}({a},{b}),{a})", F_CALC)
            wb.defined_names[f"RNG_Dem004_{nm}_{tag}"] = DefinedName(f"RNG_Dem004_{nm}_{tag}", attr_text=f"Alloc!$C${r}")
            if tag == "Lo":
                rl = r
            else:
                put(ws, f"D{r}", f"={nm}", F_LINK)
                put(ws, f"E{r}", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(D{r}),ISNUMBER(C{rl}),ISNUMBER(C{r})),IF(OR(D{r}<C{rl}-{TOL}*ABS(C{rl})-1E-12,D{r}>C{r}+{TOL}*ABS(C{r})+1E-12),1,0),0)', F_CALC, fmt="0")
                out_cells.append(f"E{r}")
            r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "基準落在區間外的格數（三個名稱合計）", F_BOLD)
    put(ws, f"C{r}", "=" + "+".join(out_cells), F_CALC, fmt="0")
    put(ws, f"D{r}", "RNG_Dem004_OutCount：不為 0＝SRC_DEM_004 的低／高端不再涵蓋基準（Checks RG4，WARN）", F_NOTE)
    wb.defined_names["RNG_Dem004_OutCount"] = DefinedName("RNG_Dem004_OutCount", attr_text=f"Alloc!$C${r}")
    return {"row0": r0, "out_row": r, "den": at["den"]}


def o13_checks_rg4(wb):
    ws = wb["Checks"]
    if any(ws.cell(r, 1).value == "RG4" for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1)):
        return 0
    r3 = next(r for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(r, 1).value == "RG3")
    r4 = r3 + 1
    assert ws.cell(r4, 1).value in (None, ""), (r4, ws.cell(r4, 1).value)
    put(ws, f"A{r4}", "RG4")
    put(ws, f"B{r4}", "推論支出區間（SRC_DEM_004_Lo／_Hi；Alloc Q 節）：IF_AllocServeGW／IF_AllocQ1／IF_AllocQ2 任一基準落在 RNG_Dem004_*_Lo／_Hi 之外：1＝是（容差 1e-9）", wrap=True)
    put(ws, f"C{r4}", "WARN")
    put(ws, f"D{r4}", "=IF(RNG_Dem004_OutCount>0,1,0)", F_CALC, fmt="0")
    put(ws, f"E{r4}", "RNG_Dem004_OutCount；Alloc Q 節（公式區間，沒有指紋：來源區間改動時端點即時更新）", F_NOTE)
    ref = wb.defined_names["GOV_Warnings"].attr_text.split("!")[1].replace("$", "")
    cell = ws[ref]
    f = str(cell.value)
    if f"D{r4}" not in f:
        cell.value = f + f"+D{r4}"
    lab = ws[f"B{int(ref[1:])}"]
    if "RG4" not in str(lab.value):
        lab.value = str(lab.value).replace("、RG1、RG2、RG3）", "、RG1、RG2、RG3、RG4）") if "、RG1、RG2、RG3）" in str(lab.value) else f"{lab.value}、RG4"
    return 1

def b11_guard(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["Interface"]
    n = 0
    if ws["A193"].value in (None, ""):
        assert ws["A194"].value.startswith("F. Block 6"), ws["A194"].value
        src = {c.column_letter: c for c in ws[192] if c.value is not None}

        for col, cell in src.items():
            if col in "RSTUVW":
                v = cell.value
                if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("="):
                    v = re.sub(r"(?<![A-Z$])([A-Z])192(?![0-9])", r"\g<1>193", v)
                ws[f"{col}193"].value = v
                ws[f"{col}193"].font = copy(cell.font); ws[f"{col}193"].number_format = cell.number_format
                ws[f"{col}193"].alignment = copy(cell.alignment); ws[f"{col}193"].fill = copy(cell.fill)
        for col in "ABCDEFG":
            ws[f"{col}193"].fill = copy(ws[f"{col}192"].fill)
        n += 1
    wb.defined_names["IF_FrontSuccVRQual"] = DefinedName("IF_FrontSuccVRQual", attr_text="Interface!$C$193:$G$193")
    hs = wb["Harness"]
    for r in (151, 152, 153):
        n += append_text(hs[f"{_note_col(hs)}{r}"], "；v15.0 B11：可靠度下限 p_min 高到沒有組合合格時，本列回『無合格』文字（原行為不變）；數值或文字的判斷請先讀 Interface 第 193 列 IF_FrontSuccVRQual（1＝有合格組合，0＝無）")
    return n


def _note_col(ws):
    pc = _purpose_col(ws)
    return L(pc) if pc else "J"

Y9_OLD_ROW13 = {"E": 0.15, "F": 0.15, "G": 0.4, "H": 0.4}
Y9_NEW_ROW13 = {"E": 0.18, "F": 0.18, "G": 0.35, "H": 0.35}


def y9_sens(wb, append_text):
    n = 0
    sr = wb["Sens_Rev"]
    assert sr["A8"].value == "折扣 10%" or str(sr["A8"].value).startswith("="), sr["A8"].value
    n += _set_guarded(sr["B8"], 0.1, "=Cap_In!D12") if sr["B8"].value == 0.1 else 0
    if sr["B9"].value == 0.3:
        sr["B9"].value = "=Cap_In!E12"; n += 1
    for r in (8, 9):
        if sr[f"B{r}"].value != f"=Cap_In!{'D' if r == 8 else 'E'}12":
            continue
        sr[f"A{r}"].value = f'="折扣 "&TEXT(B{r},"0%")'
    st = wb["Sens_Train"]
    for c, old in Y9_OLD_ROW13.items():
        cell = st[f"{c}13"]
        if cell.value == old:
            cell.value = Y9_NEW_ROW13[c]; n += 1
        else:
            assert cell.value == Y9_NEW_ROW13[c], (c, cell.value)
    for c, old, new in (("E3", "預訓練 MFU 基準 0.15", "預訓練 MFU 基準 0.18"), ("G3", "預訓練 MFU 基準 0.40", "預訓練 MFU 基準 0.35")):
        if st[c].value == old:
            st[c].value = new; n += 1
        else:
            assert st[c].value == new, (c, st[c].value)
    n += append_text(st["A2"], "；v15.0 Y9：第 13 列『預訓練 MFU 基準』低／高端由 0.15／0.40 改為 0.18／0.35（Gov_Map GM519 區間，Andy 2026-10-03 確認；原值見 Decisions SL46-05）；Sens_Rev 折扣 10%／30% 兩列改連結 Cap_In D12／E12（0.1／0.4，原高端 0.3）")
    return n

V16_J = ("v15.0 O9（Andy 2026-10-17 13:39 照預設）：比照 V23、V24 標『恆等式（非驗證）』並移出驗證計數（22 → 21）。理由：能量閉合比是物理下限功率 ÷ 機架平均用電，"

def o6_sentinel(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["SRC_Index"]
    rows = [r for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(r, 2).value == "（哨兵）" or str(ws.cell(r, 2).value or "").startswith("=IF(A")]
    assert rows, "no sentinel rows"
    first = min(rows)
    n = 0
    for r in rows:
        f = (f'=IF(A{r}="","（哨兵：Gov_Map 該列無 SRC_ID）",IF(COUNTIF($A$5:$A${first - 1},A{r})>0,"（哨兵：此 SRC_ID 已在上方 SRC 頁，查詢不會命中本列）","（哨兵：SRC 頁查無此 ID）"))')
        if ws.cell(r, 2).value != f:
            ws.cell(r, 2).value = f; ws.cell(r, 2).font = copy(F_NOTE); n += 1
    n += append_text(ws["A2"], O6_NOTE)
    return n


# ================================================================== T1-6 O20: kappa derivation (display; reaches Checks KP row)
KAP_TITLE = ("κ 推導（v15.0 O20；顯示用，不連結 AL_Kappa；Derived）：v5.36A 第 3.2 節的方法在簿內重算——每請求 GPU 秒＝I×[(1−χ)×新鮮 prefill GPU 秒/M＋χ×快取命中 prefill GPU 秒/M]÷10^6＋O×decode GPU 秒/M÷10^6，"
             "容量＝(I＋O)÷每請求 GPU 秒，κ_i＝容量_i÷容量_參考（16,384＋2,048，χ＝Cap_In 快取命中 B4_CacheHit）；按需求 token 加權的調和平均＝1÷Σ(w_i÷κ_i)。"
             "GPU 秒/M 取 Sens_Perf 第 101–103 列 C 欄（Sol、VR200）；限制：prefill 單價固定於 ISL 16K（v5.36A 用 4K／16K 線性內插，簿內已無 4K 欄），短輸入的 prefill 成本略偏高。"
             "這是核對 AL_Kappa 基準 1.0（區間 0.65–1.2）的重算，不改 AL_Kappa；結果與區間比對見 Checks KP 列。")
KAP_TYPES = [  # label, I, O, chi (None -> B4_CacheHit), weight formula
    ("參考請求（16,384／2,048）", 16384, 2048, None, None),
    ("API（6,000／400，χ 0.55）", 6000, 400, 0.55, "AL_DAPI"),
    ("ChatGPT 付費（3,500／800，χ 0.8）", 3500, 800, 0.8, "AL_DChatPaid"),
    ("ChatGPT 免費（2,000／500，χ 0.8）", 2000, 500, 0.8, "AL_DChatFree"),
]


def o20_kappa(wb):
    ws = wb["Alloc_In"]
    if any(str(ws.cell(r, 1).value or "").startswith("κ 推導（v15.0 O20") for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1)):
        return {}
    r0 = max(c.row for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.value is not None) + 2
    section(ws, r0, KAP_TITLE, 10)
    r = r0 + 1
    for i, h in enumerate(["請求類型", "輸入 token I", "輸出 token O", "快取命中 χ", "需求 token（M tok/年）", "每請求 GPU 秒", "容量 tok/GPU 秒", "κ_i", "權重 w_i÷κ_i"]):
        put(ws, f"{L(i + 1)}{r}", h, F_BOLD, wrap=True)
    r += 1
    first = r
    ref = r
    for lab, I, O, chi, w in KAP_TYPES:
        put(ws, f"A{r}", lab)
        put(ws, f"B{r}", I, F_CALC); put(ws, f"C{r}", O, F_CALC)
        put(ws, f"D{r}", "=B4_CacheHit" if chi is None else chi, F_LINK if chi is None else F_CALC)
        put(ws, f"E{r}", f"={w}" if w else "—", F_LINK if w else F_CALC)
        put(ws, f"F{r}", f"=B{r}*((1-D{r})*Sens_Perf!$C$101+D{r}*Sens_Perf!$C$102)/1000000+C{r}*Sens_Perf!$C$103/1000000", F_CALC, fmt="0.000000")
        put(ws, f"G{r}", f"=(B{r}+C{r})/F{r}", F_CALC, fmt="#,##0")
        put(ws, f"H{r}", "（基準 1）" if r == ref else f"=G{r}/$G${ref}", F_NOTE if r == ref else F_CALC, fmt="0.000")
        put(ws, f"I{r}", f"=E{r}/H{r}" if w else "—", F_CALC, fmt="#,##0")
        r += 1
    last = r - 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "κ 重算值（需求加權調和平均＝Σw ÷ Σ(w÷κ_i)）", F_BOLD)
    put(ws, f"H{r}", f"=SUM(E{first + 1}:E{last})/SUM(I{first + 1}:I{last})", F_CALC, fmt="0.000")
    put(ws, f"I{r}", "重算值對 AL_Kappa 區間：", F_NOTE)
    r_kap = r
    r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "重算值落在 AL_Kappa 區間（0.65–1.2）內？（1＝是）", F_BOLD)
    put(ws, f"H{r}", f"=IF(AND(H{r_kap}>=AL_Kappa_Lo,H{r_kap}<=AL_Kappa_Hi),1,0)", F_CALC, fmt="0")
    r_in = r
    put(ws, f"A{r + 1}", "輸入欄 I、O、χ（黑字常數：方法常數，不是模型輸入，不登錄藍字輸入；改動請走工作單）取自 v5.36A 第 3.2 節的請求類型表（Analogy：OpenRouter／無伺服器平台追蹤、v5.33A 五組成基準）；權重為簿內 Alloc 第 5–7 列需求 token。v5.36A 的 1.035 所用 GW 權重未存於簿內，本表以需求 token 權重重算，數值可能與 1.035 不同。", F_NOTE)
    wb.defined_names["AL_KappaCalc"] = DefinedName("AL_KappaCalc", attr_text=f"Alloc_In!$H${r_kap}")
    wb.defined_names["AL_KappaCalcIn"] = DefinedName("AL_KappaCalcIn", attr_text=f"Alloc_In!$H${r_in}")
    return {"row0": r0, "kap_row": r_kap, "in_row": r_in}


def o20_checks_kp(wb):
    ws = wb["Checks"]
    if any(ws.cell(r, 1).value == "KP" for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1)):
        return 0
    r = max(c.row for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.value is not None) + 2
    section(ws, r, "KP. κ 重算對照（v15.0 O20；顯示用，不計入 GOV_*）：Alloc_In 的 κ 推導區塊重算值對 AL_Kappa（基準 1.0）與其區間", 6); r += 1
    for i, h in enumerate(["編號", "檢查", "等級", "值", "說明"]): put(ws, f"{L(i + 1)}{r}", h, F_BOLD)
    r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "KP1"); put(ws, f"B{r}", "κ 重算值 ÷ AL_Kappa（基準）", wrap=True); put(ws, f"C{r}", "INFO")
    put(ws, f"D{r}", "=AL_KappaCalc/AL_Kappa", F_CALC, fmt="0.000"); put(ws, f"E{r}", "Alloc_In κ 推導區塊；不改 AL_Kappa", F_NOTE); r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "KP2"); put(ws, f"B{r}", "κ 重算值落在 AL_Kappa 區間內（1＝是）", wrap=True); put(ws, f"C{r}", "INFO")
    put(ws, f"D{r}", "=AL_KappaCalcIn", F_CALC, fmt="0"); put(ws, f"E{r}", "0＝重算值在 0.65–1.2 之外，須由 Project 判斷是否更新 AL_Kappa", F_NOTE)
    return 1

def t3_src060(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["SRC_Perf"]
    r = next(x for x in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(x, 1).value == "SRC_PERF_060")
    n = 0
    note = ws[f"W{r}"]
    if "v15.0 更正" not in str(note.value or ""):
        old = {k: ws[f"{k}{r}"].value for k in "JNMG"}
        assert old["N"] == "二手（3A 查證轉引）", old["N"]
        tail = O5_TAIL.format(j=old["J"], n=old["N"], m=old["M"], g=old["G"])
        for k, v in O5_NEW.items():
            ws[f"{k}{r}"].value = v; n += 1
        note.value = f"{note.value}{tail}"; n += 1
    cal = wb["Calib"]
    old = "MLPerf（MLCommons 稽核）／NVIDIA 提交（v5.1；3A 查證轉引）"
    if cal["G121"].value == old:
        cal["G121"].value = "NVIDIA 自測（Interested-party；未經 MLCommons 驗證；NVIDIA 技術部落格表 2，v5.1 DGX H200）"; n += 1
        n += append_text(cal["J121"], "｜v15.0 更正（修訂九，Decisions SL46-23）：G121 原文＝『" + old + "』；SRC_PERF_060 實為 NVIDIA 自測值，非 MLCommons 稽核結果")
    ck = wb["Checks"]
    n += append_text(ck["J149"], "｜v15.0 更正：SRC_PERF_060＝556 已回查（NVIDIA 技術部落格表 2，非 MLCommons 結果；NVIDIA 自測未經驗證），上句『對照值未回查』結案；V1 判定不變（1.22，警示）；Decisions SL46-23")
    de = wb["DB_Evidence"]
    rr = next((x for x in range(5, de.max_row + 1) if de.cell(x, 1).value == "E384"), None)
    if rr:
        n += append_text(de[f"R{rr}"], "｜v15.0 回查結案：556 出自 NVIDIA 技術部落格表 2（非 MLCommons 提交）；欄 I、L 不改（CLAUDE.md 第 6 節），判定請 Project 於下一輪更新")
    return n

VR_NOTE_TITLE = "｜v15.0 T3-2：另有 12 個只經 VR200 欄的名稱（見下方（a）更正），端點＝VR200 倍數 0.70／1.0 兩個情境（tools/gen_ranges.py 的 vr200_lo／vr200_hi）每格較小／較大者"


def t3_vr_notes(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["Alloc"]
    n = 0
    for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
        s = str(ws.cell(r, 1).value or "")
        if s.startswith("O. 批次口徑倍數區間端點"):
            n += append_text(ws.cell(r, 1), VR_NOTE_TITLE)
        elif s.startswith("（a）只經 VR200 欄"):
            n += append_text(ws.cell(r, 1), VR_NOTE_A)
        elif s.startswith("（c）v13.1 P2-1：VR200 欄無區間"):
            n += append_text(ws.cell(r, 1), VR_NOTE_C)
    return n

# ================================================================== entry points
def apply(wb, append_text):
    log = {}
    log["o13_q"] = o13_alloc_q(wb)
    log["o13_rg4"] = o13_checks_rg4(wb)
    log["o14"] = o14_l1(wb, append_text)
    log["b11"] = b11_guard(wb, append_text)
    log["b20"] = b20_labels(wb, append_text)
    log["y9"] = y9_sens(wb, append_text)
    log["f16"] = f16_note(wb, append_text)
    log["o9"] = o9_v16(wb, append_text)
    log["o6"] = o6_sentinel(wb, append_text)
    log["o20"] = o20_kappa(wb)
    log["o20_kp"] = o20_checks_kp(wb)
    log["labels"] = o8_o12_labels(wb, append_text)
    log["t3_src060"] = t3_src060(wb, append_text)
    log["t3_vr_notes"] = t3_vr_notes(wb, append_text)
    ws = wb["Decisions"]
    if not any(ws.cell(r, 1).value == "SL46-01" for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)):
        log["decisions"] = v1410.decisions_append(wb, _decisions())
    return log
```

```python
def _row_of(ws, rid, col=1, first=5):
    rows = [r for r in range(first, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(r, col).value == rid]
    assert len(rows) == 1, (ws.title, rid, rows)
    return rows[0]


# ================================================================== Gov_Map (called from gov.py's update chain, before Load_Bearing is expanded)
def gov_update(ws, append_text):
    n = 0
    r = v1020._gm_row(ws, "Calib", "D67")
    if ws[f"F{r}"].value == "Analogy":
        assert ws[f"N{r}"].value == GM342_N_OLD and ws[f"K{r}"].value == GM342_K[0] and ws[f"L{r}"].value == GM342_L[0] and ws[f"M{r}"].value == GM342_M_OLD, (ws[f"N{r}"].value, ws[f"K{r}"].value)
        assert ws[f"AL{r}"].value in (None, ""), ws[f"AL{r}"].value
        ws[f"AL{r}"].value = GM342_AL
        ws[f"F{r}"].value = "Derived"
        ws[f"K{r}"].value = GM342_K[1]
        ws[f"L{r}"].value = GM342_L[1]
        ws[f"M{r}"].value = GM342_M_NEW
        n += 6
    n += int(append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], GM342_N_ADD))
    r57 = v1020._gm_row(ws, "Cap_In", "C31:E31")
    n += int(append_text(ws[f"M{r57}"], GM457_ADD))
    r44 = v1020._gm_row(ws, "Alloc_In", "C26")
    n += int(append_text(ws[f"N{r44}"], GM644_ADD))
    return n


# ================================================================== V1 / V3 (late; Excel-owned cells)
def b2(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    assert str(ws["A280"].value).startswith("2025 年度層級單價：Astra"), ws["A280"].value
    n = 0
    for c in "CDE":
        cur = ws[f"{c}280"].value
        if cur == B2_NEW[c]:
            continue
        assert cur == B2_OLD[c], (c, cur)
        ws[f"{c}280"].value = B2_NEW[c]; n += 1
    a = ws["A280"].value
    if A280_OLD in a:
        ws["A280"].value = a.replace(A280_OLD, A280_NEW); n += 1
    else:
        assert A280_NEW in a, a
    n += int(append_text(ws["G280"], G280_NOTE))
    return n


def b3_b4(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["Calib"]
    n = 0
    cur = ws["D67"].value
    if cur != D67_NEW:
        assert cur == D67_OLD, cur
        ws["D67"].value = D67_NEW; n += 1
    n += int(append_text(ws["J67"], J67_ADD))
    g9 = ws["G9"].value
    if g9 != G9_NEW:
        assert g9 == G9_OLD, g9
        ws["G9"].value = G9_NEW; n += 1
    return n


def b1_j2(wb, append_text):
    ws = wb["SRC_Demand"]
    r4, r18 = _row_of(ws, "SRC_DEM_004"), _row_of(ws, "SRC_DEM_018")
    assert ws[f"D{r4}"].value == 7.5, ws[f"D{r4}"].value          # B1: Lo stays 7.5
    n = int(append_text(ws[f"W{r4}"], W8_ADD))
    b = ws[f"B{r18}"].value
    if b != B22_NEW:
        assert b == B22_OLD, b
        ws[f"B{r18}"].value = B22_NEW; n += 1
    n += int(append_text(ws[f"W{r18}"], W22_ADD))
    return n

def evidence_append(wb):
    ws = wb["DB_Evidence"]
    have = {ws.cell(r, 1).value for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)}
    r = max(rr for rr in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(rr, 1).value not in (None, "")) + 1
    n = 0
    from common import put, F_CALC
    for (eid, claim, src, mark, param, cur, new, verdict, note, affected, stance) in EVIDENCE:
        if eid in have:
            continue
        status = "待判定" if verdict.startswith("待查") else "已處理"
        vals = [eid, DATE, claim, src, mark, param, cur, new, verdict, V, note + "｜" + EV_COMMON, status, "—", "—", affected, "—", stance,
                f"{verdict}｜v15.2 新增列（非 106 列積壓）"]
        for i, v in enumerate(vals):
            put(ws, f"{L(i + 1)}{r}", v, F_CALC, wrap=i in (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 14, 17))
        r += 1; n += 1
    return n

         "Andy 2026-10-17 21:20「照建議繼續下去」（B1–B6 依預設）；chat 端建議，可撤回",
         "Cap_In C280:E280（A280、G280）；Calib D67、G9（J67）；Gov_Map GM342（F、K、L、M、N、AL）、GM457 M"),
    ]
    return [[f"SL47-{i + 1:02d}", V, f"v15.2 m 證據 B 段：{t}", txt, DATE, who, "v15.2 已建", where, f"{WO} V4-{i + 1}", "否"]
            for i, (t, txt, who, where) in enumerate(D)]


def apply(wb, append_text):
    log = {}
    log["b2"] = b2(wb, append_text)
    log["b3_b4"] = b3_b4(wb, append_text)
    log["b1_j2"] = b1_j2(wb, append_text)
    log["evidence"] = evidence_append(wb)
    ws = wb["Decisions"]
    if not any(ws.cell(r, 1).value == "SL47-01" for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)):
        log["decisions"] = v1410.decisions_append(wb, _decisions())
    return log
```

```python
def _al_text(dec, f_old, m_old, k_old=None):
    return ("v15.3 更正（修訂九，Decisions " + dec + "）前的原值：類別＝" + f_old + "｜區間文字（M 欄）＝" + m_old + "｜理由（N 欄）原文保留於 N 欄（v15.3 說明附加於其後）")


def gov_update(ws, append_text):
    n = 0
    for (sh, cell), d in GM_ROWS.items():
        r = v1020._gm_row(ws, sh, cell)
        if ws[f"F{r}"].value == d["f_old"]:
            assert ws[f"M{r}"].value == d["m_old"], (cell, ws[f"M{r}"].value)
            assert ws[f"AL{r}"].value in (None, ""), ws[f"AL{r}"].value
            ws[f"AL{r}"].value = _al_text(d["dec"], d["f_old"], d["m_old"])
            ws[f"F{r}"].value = d["f_new"]
            ws[f"M{r}"].value = d["m_new"]
            n += 3
        else:
            assert ws[f"F{r}"].value == d["f_new"], (cell, ws[f"F{r}"].value)
        n += int(append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], "｜" + d["n_add"]))
    r = v1020._gm_row(ws, "Cap_In", "C227")      # E3: no change, note only
    n += int(append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], "｜" + E3_TXT))
    r = v1020._gm_row(ws, "Calib", "D156")       # C2
    if ws[f"K{r}"].value == GM685_K[0]:
        assert ws[f"L{r}"].value == GM685_L[0], ws[f"L{r}"].value
        ws[f"K{r}"].value = GM685_K[1]; ws[f"L{r}"].value = GM685_L[1]; n += 2
    else:
        assert ws[f"K{r}"].value == GM685_K[1] and ws[f"L{r}"].value == GM685_L[1], (ws[f"K{r}"].value, ws[f"L{r}"].value)
    n += int(append_text(ws[f"M{r}"], GM685_M_ADD))
    n += int(append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], GM685_N_ADD))
    for (sh, cell), (old, new) in GM_E_LABELS.items():      # r1: stale marks in the Gov_Map E (item label) column; originals quoted in Decisions SL48-09
        r = v1020._gm_row(ws, sh, cell)
        if ws[f"E{r}"].value != new:
            assert ws[f"E{r}"].value == old, (cell, ws[f"E{r}"].value)
            ws[f"E{r}"].value = new; n += 1
    return n


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cell edits (before gov_all)
def _row_by_label(ws, prefix, lo=200, hi=300):
    rows = [r for r in range(lo, hi) if str(ws.cell(r, 1).value or "").startswith(prefix)]
    assert len(rows) == 1, (prefix, rows)
    return rows[0]


def inputs_update(wb, append_text):
    """W1 inputs/formulas/marks, W2 rows 242-243, W3 Calib D156 (old-value / old-text guards; idempotent on a v15.3 base)."""
    log = []
    from common import put, F_CALC
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    rg = _row_by_label(ws, "中階 token 牌價年變化率 g（I-1")
    r3 = _row_by_label(ws, "降級前服務中階的年數 T1")
    rr = _row_by_label(ws, "降級後價值比 ρ（I-3")
    assert (rg, r3, rr) == (226, 227, 228), (rg, r3, rr)
    for c in "CDE":                                                  # E1
        cur = ws[f"{c}{rg}"].value
        if cur == G_NEW[c]:
            continue
        assert cur == G_OLD[c], (c, cur)
        ws[f"{c}{rg}"].value = G_NEW[c]; log.append(f"Cap_In!{c}{rg}: {G_OLD[c]} -> {G_NEW[c]} (v15.3 E1)")
    assert ws[f"C{rr}"].value == 0.5 and [ws[f"{c}{r3}"].value for c in "CDE"] == [4, 3, 5]      # E2 base and E3 unchanged
    cur = ws[f"E{rr}"].value                                          # E2
    if cur != RHO_E_NEW:
        assert cur == RHO_E_OLD, cur
        ws[f"E{rr}"].value = RHO_E_NEW; log.append(f"Cap_In!E{rr}: {RHO_E_OLD} -> {RHO_E_NEW} (v15.3 E2)")
    cur = ws[f"D{rr}"].value
    if cur != RHO_D_NEW:
        assert cur == RHO_D_OLD, cur
        ws[f"D{rr}"].value = RHO_D_NEW; log.append(f"Cap_In!D{rr}: formula -> {RHO_D_NEW} (v15.3 E2)")
    for r, old, new in ((rg, F226_OLD, F226_NEW), (rr, F228_OLD, F228_NEW)):      # marks (revision 9: original kept in G and Gov_Map AL)
        cur = ws[f"F{r}"].value
        if cur != new:
            assert cur == old, (r, cur)
            ws[f"F{r}"].value = new; log.append(f"Cap_In!F{r}: {old} -> {new} (v15.3, revision 9)")
    log.append(f"Cap_In G226/G228 appended: {int(append_text(ws[f'G{rg}'], CAP_G226_ADD)) + int(append_text(ws[f'G{rr}'], CAP_G228_ADD))}")
    # ---- W2: rows 242 / 243
    assert ws["A242"].value in (A242_OLD, A242_NEW) and ws["A243"].value in (A243_OLD, A243_NEW), (ws["A242"].value, ws["A243"].value)
    if ws["A242"].value == A242_OLD:
        assert ws["C242"].value.startswith(C242_OLD_HEAD), ws["C242"].value
    ws["A242"].value = A242_NEW; ws["A243"].value = A243_NEW
    for c, f in (("C", C242_NEW), ("D", D242_NEW), ("E", E242_NEW)):
        put(ws, f"{c}242", f, F_CALC)
    log.append(f"Cap_In G242/G243 appended: {int(append_text(ws['G242'], G242_ADD)) + int(append_text(ws['G243'], G243_ADD))}")
    # ---- W3: Calib D156 (formula; black font = calculated, no longer an input)
    cal = wb["Calib"]
    assert str(cal["A156"].value).startswith("批次口徑 η_d 倍數（X10；CAL_BatchEtaD）"), cal["A156"].value
    assert str(cal["A254"].value).startswith("達標所需批次口徑 η_d 倍數（CAL_BatchEtaD 的解）") and str(cal["A201"].value).startswith("達標所需 η_d 倍數（相對 CAL_EtaD"), (cal["A254"].value, cal["A201"].value)
    cur = cal["D156"].value
    if cur != D156_NEW:
        assert cur == D156_OLD, cur
        put(cal, "D156", D156_NEW, F_CALC, fmt="0.000"); log.append("Calib!D156: 2.36 -> " + D156_NEW + " (v15.3 C2)")
    log.append(f"Calib J156/H156 appended: {int(append_text(cal['J156'], CAL_J156_ADD)) + int(append_text(cal['H156'], CAL_H156_ADD))}")
    return log

P89_OLD_SUB = 'IF(M89>=D107,"回本","未回本")'
P89_STATE = ('IF(AND(ISNUMBER(E88),ISNUMBER(F88),ISNUMBER(E107),ISNUMBER(F107)),IF(F88<E107,"未回本",IF(E88>F107,"回本","未定")),'
             'IF(M89>=D107,"回本","未回本"))')


def l1_text(wb):
    ws = wb["L1"]
    n = 0
    for ref, old, new in L1_SUB_EDITS:
        cur = ws[ref].value
        if new in cur:
            continue
        assert cur.count(old) == 1, (ref, cur)
        ws[ref].value = cur.replace(old, new); n += 1
    cur = ws["P89"].value      # D1 (r1): L1 P89 three-state, identity reading, same rule as Cap_In C242 (intervals non-numeric -> falls back to the point comparison)
    if P89_STATE not in cur:
        assert cur.count(P89_OLD_SUB) == 2, cur
        ws["P89"].value = cur.replace(P89_OLD_SUB, P89_STATE); n += 1
    ci = wb["Cap_In"]
    for ref, old, new in (("A226", A226_OLD, A226_NEW), ("A228", A228_OLD, A228_NEW)):
        if ci[ref].value != new:
            assert ci[ref].value == old, (ref, ci[ref].value)
            ci[ref].value = new; n += 1
    cur = ci["A230"].value
    if A230_NEW_SUB not in cur:
        assert cur.count(A230_OLD_SUB) == 1, cur
        ci["A230"].value = cur.replace(A230_OLD_SUB, A230_NEW_SUB); n += 1
    for ref, old, new in L1_EDITS:
        cur = ws[ref].value
        if cur == new:
            continue
        assert cur == old, (ref, cur)
        ws[ref].value = new; n += 1
    return n

     "部分採用（E4，只記錄）", "長約只把價格風險轉給出租方，不提高實驗室的 L；轉知 company-models 的 neocloud 模型", "不改任何 IF_／L1_", "利害關係方"),
    ("E397", "雲端折舊年限：MSFT 2–6、GOOGL 6、ORCL 6、CRWV 6、META 5.5（2025 起）、AMZN 部分伺服器 6→5（2025）",
     EV_DIR + "/L2_hardware.md（各家 10-K）", "Verified（10-K）",
     "IF_DeprLifeIT（6 年；對照，不改）", "6 年", "2–6 年（會計年限）",
     "登錄（對照 IF_DeprLifeIT 6 年，不改）", "會計年限不等於經濟年限；Burry 主張經濟壽命 2～3 年（放空者，Interested-party）", "不改任何 IF_／L1_", "—"),
]


def evidence_append(wb):
    ws = wb["DB_Evidence"]
    have = {ws.cell(r, 1).value for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)}
    r = max(rr for rr in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(rr, 1).value not in (None, "")) + 1
    n = 0
    from common import put, F_CALC
    for (eid, claim, src, mark, param, cur, new, verdict, note, affected, stance) in EVIDENCE:
        if eid in have:
            continue
        vals = [eid, DATE, claim, src, mark, param, cur, new, verdict, V, note + "｜" + EV_COMMON, "已處理", "—", "—", affected, "—", stance,
                f"{verdict}｜v15.3 新增列（非 106 列積壓）"]
        for i, v in enumerate(vals):
            put(ws, f"{L(i + 1)}{r}", v, F_CALC, wrap=i in (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 14, 17))
        r += 1; n += 1
    return n


def apply(wb, append_text):
    log = {}
    log["l1_text"] = l1_text(wb)
    log["evidence"] = evidence_append(wb)
    ws = wb["Decisions"]
    if not any(ws.cell(r, 1).value == "SL48-01" for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)):
        log["decisions"] = v1410.decisions_append(wb, _decisions())
    # final guard: the early cell edits must have survived every later builder step
    ci = wb["Cap_In"]
    # v16.0: Cap_In row 242 is rewritten afterwards by v1600.inputs_update (L side reads L1_LTotalFleetV), so only its head is checked here
    assert str(ci["C242"].value).startswith("=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(L1_LTotal") and ci["D228"].value == RHO_D_NEW and wb["Calib"]["D156"].value == D156_NEW, "v15.3 cell edits were overwritten by a later builder step"
    return log


# ================================================================== README
README_VERSION = (VERSION + "（次版：" + WO + "——L 證據 B 段＋v15.2 修補：E1 Cap_In C226:E226（g）−0.10／−0.25／+0.05 → −0.09／−0.20／+0.05；"
                  "E2 Cap_In D228（ρ 低端）公式乘低階模型每 GPU 吞吐倍數（GB200 欄，約 0.17）、E228 1.0 → 0.7；E1／E2 標記 Assumed → Derived（修訂九更正）；E3 T1 維持；"
                  "D1 Cap_In 第 242 列改三態判讀（L 區間對所需 L 區間，恆等式讀法）、第 243 列改標對照；C2 Calib D156（CAL_BatchEtaD GB200）2.36 → =SQRT(C254*D201/$D$67)（約 2.050），Gov_Map GM685 區間 1.59–2.64；"
                  "Gov_Map AA 欄 Decisions 檢查範圍 300 → 1000；Decisions SL48-01…09（含 r1 同口徑更正、L1 P89 三態、過期標籤更新）；DB_Evidence E393…E397；區間端點、指紋、Alloc N 節靜態表重產。具名範圍、定義不變。）以下為 "
                  + v1520.README_VERSION.split("_Tokenomics_", 1)[1])
_T = v1520.README_TITLE
README_TITLE = V + _T[len(v1520.V):]
README_ROW = ("v15.3 L 證據 B 段＋修補",
              "g 基準 −0.09（區間 −0.20～+0.05）、ρ 低端乘吞吐倍數 0.17／高端 0.7（皆改 Derived）；回本判讀改三態（L 區間對所需 L 區間）；CAL_BatchEtaD GB200 改兩反推點幾何平均公式（約 2.050）。名稱與定義不變。細節見 Decisions SL48-01…09（含 r1 同口徑更正、L1 P89 三態、過期標籤更新）。")
```

```python
# v16.0 (work order docs/workorders/20261018_v16.0_L世代起點.md r0, branch claude/v16-0): L measured from each generation's own start (major version: new contract names).
#   W1  Cap_In section N "L 世代起點（v16.0）" below the M section (nothing above moves): generation service start s_v (base/low/high), calibration anchor A, pre-anchor price change g_pre,
#       t0 = MAX(0, A - s_v), L_rel (relative to the anchor), revenue weights, fleet L -> L1_LTotalFleetV (+_Lo/_Hi), per-generation L -> L1_LTotalV (4 cells),
#       discounted L -> L1_LTotalDisc (+_Lo/_Hi), required L without kappa -> L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK (+_Lo/_Hi).
#   W2  Cap_In row 242 reads L1_LTotalFleetV (three-state); three comparison rows (2025 = year 0 / fleet L vs no-kappa required L / discounted L vs no-kappa required L);
#       L1 row 89 P reads L1_LTotalFleetV; four L1 rows appended after the last row.
#   W3  Decisions SL49-01..04, DB_Evidence E398, README, contract document (outside the workbook).
# Every write to an Excel-owned cell is guarded (old text); no existing input value changes. Cap_In 242 is rewritten from the v15.3 text (v1530 writes it first on every build), so the edit is deterministic.
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter as L
from openpyxl.workbook.defined_name import DefinedName

from common import put, F_IN, F_NOTE, F_BOLD, F_CALC, F_LINK, FILL_KEY
import v1000
import v1020
import v1400
import v1410
import v1530

VERSION = "20261018_Tokenomics_v16.0"      # single source of the version string: README!B5 and README!A1 (finish.readme)
DATE = "2026-10-18"
V = "v16.0"
WO = "工作單 docs/workorders/20261018_v16.0_L世代起點.md（r0）"
DASH = "—"
DEC_BY = ("Andy 2026-10-18 10:20「L 应该就是衡量在这个硬体的生命周期里，token 的价格的下跌趋势…本来就是 L 本来就是应该用自己每个世代来算的。我们用二零二五，其实是只是一个锚点，因为二零二五已经过去了，"
          "而且有比较多的一个数据，所以我们是当做一个锚点了。…不然你不可能未来几年，我们都还是用二零二五年来算，毕竟我们这东西算出来之后是要去预期或预估未来的一个状况嘛。」；10:24「合併」"
          "（同意 chat 端 10:21 提出的 v15.4 方向，合併後開工）；數值為 chat 端建議，可撤回")
DEF_TXT = ("L＝某一世代硬體在其壽命期 T 內，token 單價相對該世代『起點』單價的平均（跌價＋降級）。每個世代從自己的起點算。2025 年是校準錨點（觀察營收與支出的年度），不是 L 的起點。"
           "現行 L1_LTotal 的公式就是『新世代、起點＝第 0 年』的 L，保留不改。")

GENS = ("Hopper", "GB200", "GB300", "VR200")
SV_BASE = (2023.5, 2025.0, 2025.5, 2026.75)
SV_LO = (2023.0, 2025.0, 2025.5, 2026.75)      # earlier
SV_HI = (2024.0, 2025.5, 2025.6, 2027.0)       # later
ANCHOR = 2025.5
GPRE = (-0.09, -0.30, -0.09)                    # C base, D low, E high

ROWS = {}      # key -> Cap_In row (filled by cap_in_n)
PURPOSE_MARKS = {}      # Cap_In row -> 用途 text for the dead display cells (written in apply)
SEC_TITLE = "N. L 世代起點（v16.0；" + WO + "）：" + DEF_TXT

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- formulas
def _ln(x): return f"LN(1+{x})"


def lrel_formula(col, t0cell, c, gp):
    """L_rel of generation column `col`: t0cell = that generation's t0 (Cap_In cell), c = scenario column (C base / D low / E high) of the g, T1, rho, T rows, gp = g_pre cell."""
    g, t1, rho, T = f"${c}$226", f"${c}$227", f"${c}$228", f"${c}$229"
    t0 = t0cell
    past = f"IF({t0}>0,IF(ABS({_ln(gp)})<0.000000000001,{t0},(1-(1+{gp})^(-{t0}))/{_ln(gp)}),0)"
    a, b = f"({t1}-{t0})", f"({T}-{t0})"
    fut = (f"IF(ABS({_ln(g)})<0.000000000001,{a}+{rho}*({b}-{a}),(((1+{g})^{a}-1)+{rho}*((1+{g})^{b}-(1+{g})^{a}))/{_ln(g)})")
    return f'=IF({t0}>{t1},"t0 > T1（已降級，未支援）",({past}+{fut})/{T})'


def fleet_formula(lrow, wrow):
    w, l = f"$C${wrow}:$F${wrow}", f"$C${lrow}:$F${lrow}"
    return (f'=IF(COUNT({w})<4,AL_UnavailTxt,IF(SUM({w})<=0,AL_UnavailTxt,IF(SUMPRODUCT(ISTEXT({l})*({w}>0))>0,'
            f'"含 t0 > T1 的世代（已降級，未支援）",SUMPRODUCT({w},{l})/SUM({w}))))')


def disc_formula(c, wacc):
    g, t1, rho, T = f"{c}$226", f"{c}$227", f"{c}$228", f"{c}$229"
    a = f"({_ln(g)}-LN(1+{wacc}))"
    d = f"(-LN(1+{wacc}))"
    num = f"IF(ABS({a})<0.000000000001,{t1}+{rho}*({T}-{t1}),((EXP({a}*{t1})-1)+{rho}*(EXP({a}*{T})-EXP({a}*{t1})))/{a})"
    den = f"IF(ABS({d})<0.000000000001,{T},(EXP({d}*{T})-1)/{d})"
    return f"={num}/{den}"


def idnok_formula(num, den_basis):
    return (f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER({num}),ISNUMBER({den_basis}),ISNUMBER(SRC_DEM_007)),IF({den_basis}*SRC_DEM_007>0,{num}/({den_basis}*SRC_DEM_007),AL_UnavailTxt),AL_UnavailTxt)')


def tri(lb, llo, lhi, rb, rlo, rhi, lname="L"):
    num = ",".join(f"ISNUMBER({x})" for x in (lb, llo, lhi, rb, rlo, rhi))
    return (f'=IF(AND({num}),IF({lhi}<{rlo},"未回本（L 區間全在所需 L 之下）",IF({llo}>{rhi},"回本（L 區間全在所需 L 之上）",'
            f'"未定（區間重疊；基準 {lname} "&TEXT({lb},"0.000")&" 對所需 L "&TEXT({rb},"0.000")&"）")),"所需 L 或 L 非數字（本情境）")')

    lrel_hi="L_rel（高端組合：g、T1、ρ 取 E 欄，g_pre 取 D 欄 −0.30，t0 取高端組合）",
    w="2025 營收權重 w_v＝AL_ShareGen_v × 該世代每 GW 付費營收（2025 單價，AL_RevGW25）",
    fleet="機隊 L（世代起點，錨點 2025）＝Σ w_v × L_rel_v ÷ Σ w_v　→ L1_LTotalFleetV（D 欄＝低端組合、E 欄＝高端組合）",

    j_a="對照：2025＝第 0 年（v15.3 口徑）：L1_LTotal 區間 對 所需 L（L1_LReqFleet_Id）區間；三態",

def cap_in_n(wb, m_sec):
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    r0 = m_sec["end"] + 2
    assert ws.max_row == m_sec["end"], (ws.max_row, m_sec["end"])
    put(ws, f"A{r0}", SEC_TITLE, F_BOLD, wrap=True)
    r = r0 + 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "欄位：世代列 C Hopper／D GB200／E GB300／F VR200（與 Alloc 第 16–18 列世代順序一致）；情境列 C 基準／D 低端／E 高端；G 標記、H 說明、O 用途", F_NOTE, wrap=True)
    for col, g in zip("CDEF", GENS):
        put(ws, f"{col}{r}", g, F_BOLD)
    r += 1
    order = ["sv", "sv_lo", "sv_hi", "anchor", "gpre", "t0", "t0_lo", "t0_hi", "lrel", "lrel_lo", "lrel_hi", "w", "fleet", "lv", "disc", "idnok", "j_a", "j_b", "j_c"]
    for k in order:
        ROWS[k] = r; r += 1
    R = ROWS

    def row(k, unit, vals, tag, fmt, blue=False, key=False, purpose=None):
        rr = R[k]
        put(ws, f"A{rr}", LAB[k], wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{rr}", unit)
        for col, v in zip("CDEF", vals):
            if v is None:
                continue
            isf = isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("=")
            put(ws, f"{col}{rr}", v, (F_IN if blue else (F_LINK if isf and "!" in v else F_CALC)), fmt=fmt, fill=FILL_KEY if (key and col == "C") else None)
        put(ws, f"G{rr}", tag, F_NOTE); put(ws, f"H{rr}", NOTE[k], F_NOTE, wrap=True)
        if purpose:
            PURPOSE_MARKS[rr] = purpose      # written by apply() into the 用途 column (created by v1010／v1400 later in the build)

    row("sv", "年", SV_BASE, "Assumed", "0.00", blue=True, key=True)
    row("sv_lo", "年", SV_LO, "Assumed", "0.00", blue=True)
    row("sv_hi", "年", SV_HI, "Assumed", "0.00", blue=True)
    row("anchor", "年", (ANCHOR,), "Decision", "0.00", blue=True)
    row("gpre", "%", GPRE, "Assumed", "0.0%", blue=True)
    A = f"$C${R['anchor']}"
    row("t0", "年", [f"=MAX(0,{A}-{c}{R['sv']})" for c in "CDEF"], "Derived", "0.00")
    row("t0_lo", "年", [f"=MAX(0,{A}-{c}{R['sv_hi']})" for c in "CDEF"], "Derived", "0.00")
    row("t0_hi", "年", [f"=MAX(0,{A}-{c}{R['sv_lo']})" for c in "CDEF"], "Derived", "0.00")
    gp = lambda c: f"${c}${R['gpre']}"
    row("lrel", "x", [lrel_formula(c, f"{c}{R['t0']}", "C", gp("C")) for c in "CDEF"], "Derived", "0.0000")
    row("lrel_lo", "x", [lrel_formula(c, f"{c}{R['t0_lo']}", "D", gp("E")) for c in "CDEF"], "Derived", "0.0000")
    row("lrel_hi", "x", [lrel_formula(c, f"{c}{R['t0_hi']}", "E", gp("D")) for c in "CDEF"], "Derived", "0.0000")
    row("w", "$B/GW/年", [f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(INDEX(AL_ShareGen,1,{i})),ISNUMBER(INDEX(AL_RevGW25,1,{i}))),INDEX(AL_ShareGen,1,{i})*INDEX(AL_RevGW25,1,{i}),IF(AND(ISNUMBER(INDEX(AL_ShareGen,1,{i})),INDEX(AL_ShareGen,1,{i})=0),0,AL_UnavailTxt))'
                           for i in (1, 2, 3, 4)], "Derived", "0.000")
    row("fleet", "x", [fleet_formula(R["lrel"], R["w"]), fleet_formula(R["lrel_lo"], R["w"]), fleet_formula(R["lrel_hi"], R["w"])], "Derived", "0.0000", key=True)
    row("lv", "x", ["=L1_LTotal"] * 4, "Derived", "0.0000")
    row("disc", "x", [disc_formula("C", "Inputs!$E$28"), disc_formula("D", "Inputs!$D$28"), disc_formula("E", "Inputs!$F$28")], "Derived", "0.0000")
    row("idnok", "x", [idnok_formula("SRC_DEM_004", "AL_SpendBasis"), idnok_formula("SRC_DEM_004_Lo", "AL_SpendBasis_Hi"), idnok_formula("SRC_DEM_004_Hi", "AL_SpendBasis_Lo")], "Derived", "0.0000")
    row("j_a", "x", [tri("L1_LTotal", "L1_LTotal_Lo", "L1_LTotal_Hi", "L1_LReqFleet_Id", "L1_LReqFleet_Id_Lo", "L1_LReqFleet_Id_Hi", "L（2025＝第 0 年）")], "Derived", None,
        purpose="顯示用：C%d（對照列：2025＝第 0 年，v15.3 口徑）" % R["j_a"])
    row("j_b", "x", [tri("L1_LTotalFleetV", "L1_LTotalFleetV_Lo", "L1_LTotalFleetV_Hi", "L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK", "L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK_Lo", "L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK_Hi", "世代起點 L")], "Derived", None,
        purpose="顯示用：C%d（對照列：世代起點 L 對不含 κ 所需 L）" % R["j_b"])
    row("j_c", "x", [tri("L1_LTotalDisc", "L1_LTotalDisc_Lo", "L1_LTotalDisc_Hi", "L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK", "L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK_Lo", "L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK_Hi", "折現版 L")], "Derived", None,
        purpose="顯示用：C%d（對照列：折現版 L 對不含 κ 所需 L）" % R["j_c"])
    for col in "CDEF":
        pass
    return dict(start=r0, end=r - 1, rows=dict(R))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Gov_Map rows (blue inputs)
def gov_map_rows(wb):
    if not ROWS:
        return []
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    R = ROWS
    out = []
    sc = "切片三（v16.0 L 世代起點）"
    basis = ("v16.0 W1（" + WO + "；Decisions SL49-04）：世代服務起點依 Cap_In 第 272–274 列已登錄的雲端供應日期（H100 2023-03-21；GB200 2025-02-04；GB300 2025-07-03；VR200 2026-09-30），"
             "OpenAI 機隊放量取其後；Hopper 機隊多在 2023 年中至 2024 年建成。只進 Cap_In N 節與 L1_LTotalFleetV／LTotalV；DB_Evidence E398")

    def ent(k, cell, role, cls, dec, lo, hi, rtext, reason, seg="無"):
        lab = ws[f"A{R[k]}"].value
        out.append({'scope': sc, 'sheet': 'Cap_In', 'cell': cell.format(r=R[k]), 'label': lab, 'check': lab, 'cls': cls, 'role': role, 'src': '', 'rel': '', 'dec': dec,
                    'lo': (lo.format(r=R[k]) if isinstance(lo, str) else lo), 'hi': (hi.format(r=R[k]) if isinstance(hi, str) else hi), 'rtext': rtext, 'reason': reason, 'retag': '', 'seg': seg})

    ent("sv", "C{r}:F{r}", "單值", "Assumed", "SL49-04", None, None, "基準 2023.5／2025.0／2025.5／2026.75（區間見 s_v 低／高兩列）", basis)
    ent("sv_lo", "C{r}:F{r}", "低", "Assumed", "SL49-04", None, None, "較早端 2023.0／2025.0／2025.5／2026.75（s_v 基準的低端）", basis, seg="—")
    ent("sv_hi", "C{r}:F{r}", "高", "Assumed", "SL49-04", None, None, "較晚端 2024.0／2025.5／2025.6／2027.0（s_v 基準的高端）", basis, seg="—")
    ent("anchor", "C{r}", "單值", "Decision", "SL49-01", None, None, "單值 2025.5（Decision）",
        "v16.0 W1（SL49-01）：校準錨點年 A＝2025 營收與支出的年中；2025 是校準錨點（觀察營收與支出的年度），不是 L 的起點；Andy 2026-10-18 10:20 語音。只進 Cap_In N 節 t0")
    reason_gp = ("v16.0 W1（Decisions SL49-04）：錨點前中階牌價年變化率 g_pre，基準 −0.09（同 g）、低 −0.30（2023–24 一次性重估，年化約 −55% 的一部分；當時量小，證據最弱）、高 −0.09；"
                 "低端組合取 −0.09、高端組合取 −0.30；只在 t0 > 0 的世代進入 L_rel；只進 Cap_In N 節與 L1_LTotalFleetV")
    ent("gpre", "C{r}", "基準", "Assumed", "SL49-04", "=Cap_In!D{r}", "=Cap_In!E{r}", "−0.30～−0.09（D 欄＝低 −0.30、E 欄 −0.09）", reason_gp)
    ent("gpre", "D{r}:E{r}", "低／高", "Assumed", "SL49-04", None, None, "C{r} 的低（−0.30）、高（−0.09）端點".replace("{r}", str(R["gpre"])), reason_gp, seg="—")
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Cap_In row 242 / A242 / G242 (before gov_all)
A242_OLD = v1530.A242_NEW
A242_NEW = "判讀：世代起點 L 區間 對 所需 L 區間（恆等式讀法 L1_LReqFleet_Id；三態：未回本／未定／回本；v16.0 起 L 側讀 L1_LTotalFleetV）"
G242_ADD = ("｜v16.0 W2：本列 L 側改讀 L1_LTotalFleetV（世代起點 L，區間 [L1_LTotalFleetV_Lo, L1_LTotalFleetV_Hi]）；所需 L 側不變（L1_LReqFleet_Id）；三態規則同 v15.3 D1。"
            "v15.3 口徑（2025＝第 0 年，L 側讀 L1_LTotal）保留為 Cap_In N 節對照列；Andy 2026-10-18 10:20 定義見 Decisions SL49-01／02")


def inputs_update(wb, append_text):
    log = []
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    assert ws["A242"].value in (v1530.A242_NEW, A242_NEW), ws["A242"].value
    n = 0
    for c in "CDE":
        cur = ws[f"{c}242"].value
        assert isinstance(cur, str) and cur.startswith("=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(L1_LTotal"), cur[:60]
        if "L1_LTotalFleetV" not in cur:
            ws[f"{c}242"].value = cur.replace("L1_LTotal", "L1_LTotalFleetV"); n += 1
    ws["A242"].value = A242_NEW
    n += int(append_text(ws["G242"], G242_ADD))
    log.append(f"Cap_In row 242 reads L1_LTotalFleetV ({n} edits)")
    return log

def late_names(wb):
    """After l1_sheet: L1_LTotalV is the 4-cell Cap_In row (not the L1 D cell); the auto-created _Lo／_Hi names of that row are dropped (work order names L1_LTotalV only)."""
    r = ROWS["lv"]
    wb.defined_names["L1_LTotalV"] = DefinedName("L1_LTotalV", attr_text=f"Cap_In!$C${r}:$F${r}")
    for n in ("L1_LTotalV_Lo", "L1_LTotalV_Hi"):
        if n in wb.defined_names:
            del wb.defined_names[n]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- L1 P89 (late: needs the final L1 row number of L1_LTotalFleetV)
def l1_p89(wb):
    ws = wb["L1"]
    fv = int(wb.defined_names["L1_LTotalFleetV"].attr_text.split("$")[-1])
    assert ws[f"A{fv}"].value == "L1_LTotalFleetV", (fv, ws[f"A{fv}"].value)
    assert ws["A89"].value == "L1_LReqFleet", ws["A89"].value
    cur = ws["P89"].value
    if f"D{fv}" in cur:
        return 0
    reps = [
        ("ISNUMBER(D89),ISNUMBER(D107),ISNUMBER(M89)", f"ISNUMBER(D89),ISNUMBER(D107),ISNUMBER(D{fv})", 1),
        ("AND(ISNUMBER(E88),ISNUMBER(F88),ISNUMBER(E107),ISNUMBER(F107))", f"AND(ISNUMBER(E{fv}),ISNUMBER(F{fv}),ISNUMBER(E107),ISNUMBER(F107))", 2),
        ('IF(F88<E107,"未回本",IF(E88>F107,"回本","未定"))', f'IF(F{fv}<E107,"未回本",IF(E{fv}>F107,"回本","未定"))', 2),
        ('IF(M89>=D107,"回本","未回本")', f'IF(D{fv}>=D107,"回本","未回本")', 2),
        ("AND(ISNUMBER(D107),ISNUMBER(M89))", f"AND(ISNUMBER(D107),ISNUMBER(D{fv}))", 1),
        ('&"）；字面讀法 "&TEXT(D89,"0.00")', '&"；v15.3 口徑 2025＝第 0 年：L "&TEXT(L1_LTotal,"0.000")&"）；字面讀法 "&TEXT(D89,"0.00")', 1),
        ('"（L_total "&TEXT(M89,"0.00")&" 對所需 L "&TEXT(D107,"0.00")', f'"（世代起點 L "&TEXT(D{fv},"0.00")&" 對所需 L "&TEXT(D107,"0.00")', 1),
        ('"（恆等式讀法：L_total "&TEXT(M89,"0.00")&" 對所需 L "&TEXT(D107,"0.00")&"；字面讀法非數字）"',
         f'"（恆等式讀法：世代起點 L "&TEXT(D{fv},"0.00")&" 對所需 L "&TEXT(D107,"0.00")&"；v15.3 口徑 2025＝第 0 年：L "&TEXT(L1_LTotal,"0.000")&"；字面讀法非數字）"', 1),
    ]
    for old, new, cnt in reps:
        assert cur.count(old) == cnt, (old, cur.count(old))
        cur = cur.replace(old, new)
    assert "M89" not in cur and "E88" not in cur
    ws["P89"].value = cur
    return 1


# ================================================================== Decisions SL49-01..04, DB_Evidence E398
def _decisions():
    D = [
        ("L 的定義：按各世代自己的起點計算；2025 只是校準錨點（Andy 原話）",
         "L＝某一世代硬體在其壽命期 T 內，token 單價相對該世代起點單價的平均（跌價＋降級）。每個世代從自己的起點算。2025 年是校準錨點（觀察營收與支出的年度），不是 L 的起點。"
         "現行 L1_LTotal 的公式就是『新世代、起點＝第 0 年』的 L，保留不改。新增 Cap_In N 節『L 世代起點』與 L1_LTotalFleetV／LTotalV。"
         "Andy 2026-10-18 10:20 原話（語音轉寫，未改字）：" + "L 应该就是衡量在这个硬体的生命周期里，token 的价格的下跌趋势…本来就是 L 本来就是应该用自己每个世代来算的。我们用二零二五，其实是只是一个锚点，因为二零二五已经过去了，"
         "而且有比较多的一个数据，所以我们是当做一个锚点了。…不然你不可能未来几年，我们都还是用二零二五年来算，毕竟我们这东西算出来之后是要去预期或预估未来的一个状况嘛。」。"
         "（Decisions SL48-01 已於 v15.3 補登 C1，本版確認、不重複。）",
         DEC_BY, "Cap_In N 節（第 %d–%d 列）；L1_LTotalFleetV、L1_LTotalV；README" % (ROWS["sv"], ROWS["j_c"])),

         "Cap_In 第 242 列三態判讀的 L 側由 L1_LTotal 改讀 L1_LTotalFleetV（所需 L 側不變，仍為 L1_LReqFleet_Id）；L1 第 89 列 P 欄的恆等式讀法同步改讀 L1_LTotalFleetV，並附『v15.3 口徑 2025＝第 0 年：L 0.660』。"
         "基準下仍為『未定』（基準 L 0.716 對所需 L 0.756）。v15.3 口徑（L1_LTotal）保留為 Cap_In N 節對照列。",
         DEC_BY, "Cap_In 第 242 列（A、C、D、E、G）、N 節對照列；L1 P89"),
        ("F1、F2 只列對照；主口徑是否改待 Andy",
         "F1：恆等式讀法的所需 L 是否改為不含 κ（L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK）；F2：L 是否改為折現版（L1_LTotalDisc）。兩者本版只列對照（Cap_In N 節三列對照、L1 新增列），不進判讀。"
         "建議預設：F1 改不含 κ、F2 以折現版為主；Andy 未回應前不改主口徑（判讀仍讀 L1_LTotalFleetV 對 L1_LReqFleet_Id）。",
         "chat 端建議（工作單 W3），Andy 尚未回應；可撤回", "Cap_In N 節；L1_LTotalDisc、L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK"),
        ("新輸入登錄：s_v（世代服務起點）、錨點年 A、g_pre（錨點前牌價年變化率）",
         "s_v 基準 2023.5／2025.0／2025.5／2026.75，低（較早）2023.0／2025.0／2025.5／2026.75，高（較晚）2024.0／2025.5／2025.6／2027.0（Assumed）；依據 Cap_In 第 272–274 列已登錄的雲端供應日期，不新增外部來源（DB_Evidence E398）。"
         "錨點年 A 2025.5（Decision）。g_pre 基準／低／高 −0.09／−0.30／−0.09（Assumed；低端反映 2023–24 一次性重估，當時量小，證據最弱）。數值為工作單 W1 所列。",
         DEC_BY, "Cap_In N 節輸入列；Gov_Map 新列；DB_Evidence E398"),
    ]

     "Cap_In N 節 s_v（基準／低／高）、錨點年 A、g_pre", "—", "s_v 基準 2023.5／2025.0／2025.5／2026.75；低 2023.0／2025.0／2025.5／2026.75；高 2024.0／2025.5／2025.6／2027.0；A 2025.5；g_pre −0.09／−0.30／−0.09",
     "採用（W1；不新增來源）", "s_v 為推定值，非一手資料；OpenAI 各世代放量時間無公開資料；Hopper 錨點前跌價證據最弱（2023–24 一次性重估，當時量小）", "L1_LTotalFleetV*；L1_LTotalV（Cap_In N 節）；不改任何既有 IF_／L1_ 值", "—"),
]


def evidence_append(wb):
    ws = wb["DB_Evidence"]
    have = {ws.cell(r, 1).value for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)}
    r = max(rr for rr in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(rr, 1).value not in (None, "")) + 1
    n = 0
    for (eid, claim, src, mark, param, cur, new, verdict, note, affected, stance) in EVIDENCE:
        if eid in have:
            continue
        vals = [eid, DATE, claim, src, mark, param, cur, new, verdict, V, note + "｜" + EV_COMMON, "已處理", "—", "—", affected, "—", stance,
                f"{verdict}｜v16.0 新增列（非 106 列積壓）"]
        for i, v in enumerate(vals):
            put(ws, f"{L(i + 1)}{r}", v, F_CALC, wrap=i in (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 14, 17))
        r += 1; n += 1
    return n


def purpose_marks(wb):
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    pc = v1400._purpose_col(ws, create=False)
    assert pc is not None, "用途 column of Cap_In not found"
    for rr, txt in PURPOSE_MARKS.items():
        put(ws, f"{L(pc)}{rr}", txt, F_NOTE)
    return len(PURPOSE_MARKS)


def clear_l1_ratio(wb):
    """L1 column O (推算 ÷ 外部) has no external value on the four new rows: cleared like the other external-less rows (v10.1 L1_O_ROWS), so they are not dead formula cells."""
    ws = wb["L1"]; n = 0
    for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
        if ws.cell(r, 1).value in ("L1_LTotalFleetV", "L1_LTotalV", "L1_LTotalDisc", "L1_LReqFleet_IdNoK") and ws[f"O{r}"].value is not None:
            ws[f"O{r}"].value = None; n += 1
    return n


def apply(wb, append_text):
    log = {}
    log["l1_o_cleared"] = clear_l1_ratio(wb)
    log["purpose"] = purpose_marks(wb)
    log["p89"] = l1_p89(wb)
    log["evidence"] = evidence_append(wb)
    ws = wb["Decisions"]
    if not any(ws.cell(r, 1).value == "SL49-01" for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)):
        log["decisions"] = v1410.decisions_append(wb, _decisions())
    return log

                  + v1530.README_VERSION.split("_Tokenomics_", 1)[1])
```

```python
# v17.0 (work order docs/workorders/20261020_v17.0_F1F2主口徑.md r0, branch claude/v17-0): payback reading main basis = generation-start + discounted fleet L versus the no-kappa required L (F1, F2 defaults).

#   W1  Cap_In section O "L 世代起點折現（v17.0）" below section N (nothing above moves): per-generation discounted L_rel (base/low/high combinations, discounted to each generation's own start),

# Every write to an Excel-owned cell is guarded (old text / already-applied test); no input value changes.
```
